# About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

## Built on a Strong Foundation Committed to
### _R_._I_._S_._E_
Reliable
Integrated
Sustainable
Efficient

##  Efficient
######  ONE IDENTITY, GLOBAL REACH 
KLK OLEO serves our customers from world-class manufacturing facilities strategically located across Malaysia, China, Indonesia, Europe, and our newly established international sales office in the Americas. With a team of techno-commercial professionals, we are committed to delivering the beneﬁts of market knowledge, sales responsiveness and formulation support, intending to maximise efficiency and improve the quality of your products.  
With a presence in every region, we can react swiftly to your demands and deliver products of the highest standard just-in-time for your production. This will reduce carbon footprint while ensuring product integrity and quality during handling and storage.
![Reliable](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2025-RISE-Thumbnail-01.png)

##  Reliable
######  GOING THE EXTRA MILE 
Enjoy peace of mind by choosing us as your key partner. Backed by over 100 years of experience, KLK OLEO serves a range of industries and have the knowledge and expertise to help you achieve your product development goals while ensuring performance, quality and security of supply.  
Our global presence ensures that we can effectively support all our customers’ formulation objective at a local level. Reach out to us, and we will always go the extra mile to develop a product that enriches all human lives, today and tomorrow.

##  Integrated
######  DISCOVER PRODUCTS THAT TRANSFORM INDUSTRIES AND LIVES 
KLK OLEO offers a comprehensive product portfolio with high synergies from basic oleochemicals to downstream derivatives and speciality chemicals that are easily adaptable to the needs of different industries and markets. Our products have the assurance of supply reliability, traceability, and sustainability throughout the value chain, backed by our operations’ vertically and horizontally integrated nature.

##  Sustainable
######  PRODUCTS THAT MAKE A DIFFERENCE 
Meet your sustainable goals and further improve your sustainability proﬁle with KLK OLEO products. New applications such as bioactives, biofuel, biolubricants, green chemicals, bioplastics, and biopolymers will increase your ethical and environmentally friendly credentials.  
Trusted by top FMCGs worldwide, our commitment to No Deforestation, No Peat, and No Exploitation (NDPE), reducing Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions, Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) and sustainability policy throughout our supply chain and operations ensure that our products exceed the most stringent environmental standards.

# About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

# About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

# About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

# About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

# About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

# About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. # About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

# About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

# About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

# About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

# About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

# About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.
  * ![KLK OLEO 30 Years](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/30-Years-R2-01.png)

###### RSPO Supply Chain Certified (SCC)

## Built on a Strong Foundation Committed to
### _R_._I_._S_._E_
Reliable
Integrated
Sustainable
Efficient
![Efficient](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2025-RISE-Thumbnail-01.png)

##  Efficient
######  ONE IDENTITY, GLOBAL REACH 
KLK OLEO serves our customers from world-class manufacturing facilities strategically located across Malaysia, China, Indonesia, Europe, and our newly established international sales office in the Americas. With a team of techno-commercial professionals, we are committed to delivering the beneﬁts of market knowledge, sales responsiveness and formulation support, intending to maximise efficiency and improve the quality of your products.  
With a presence in every region, we can react swiftly to your demands and deliver products of the highest standard just-in-time for your production. This will reduce carbon footprint while ensuring product integrity and quality during handling and storage.
![Reliable](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2025-RISE-Thumbnail-01.png)

##  Reliable
######  GOING THE EXTRA MILE 
Enjoy peace of mind by choosing us as your key partner. Backed by over 100 years of experience, KLK OLEO serves a range of industries and have the knowledge and expertise to help you achieve your product development goals while ensuring performance, quality and security of supply.  
Our global presence ensures that we can effectively support all our customers’ formulation objective at a local level. Reach out to us, and we will always go the extra mile to develop a product that enriches all human lives, today and tomorrow.
![Integrated](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2025-RISE-Thumbnail-01.png)

##  Integrated
######  DISCOVER PRODUCTS THAT TRANSFORM INDUSTRIES AND LIVES 
KLK OLEO offers a comprehensive product portfolio with high synergies from basic oleochemicals to downstream derivatives and speciality chemicals that are easily adaptable to the needs of different industries and markets. Our products have the assurance of supply reliability, traceability, and sustainability throughout the value chain, backed by our operations’ vertically and horizontally integrated nature.
![Sustainable](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2025-RISE-Thumbnail-01.png)

##  Sustainable
######  PRODUCTS THAT MAKE A DIFFERENCE 
Meet your sustainable goals and further improve your sustainability proﬁle with KLK OLEO products. New applications such as bioactives, biofuel, biolubricants, green chemicals, bioplastics, and biopolymers will increase your ethical and environmentally friendly credentials.  
Trusted by top FMCGs worldwide, our commitment to No Deforestation, No Peat, and No Exploitation (NDPE), reducing Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions, Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) and sustainability policy throughout our supply chain and operations ensure that our products exceed the most stringent environmental standards.
![Efficient](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2025-RISE-Thumbnail-01.png)

# About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

![this is an image of a girl that is using eye drops, which has pharmaceutical-grade glycerine that acts as a non toxic and odourless lubricant.](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/EDENOR-Glycerine-Pharma-Grade.jpg)

EDENOR Glycerine is a pharmaceutical excipient. It is 100% natural and derived from renewable resources. EDENOR Glycerine is a non-toxic, hygroscopic, colourless, odourless and sweet-tasting viscous liquid. It is a good solubiliser, lubricant, plasticiser and agent for moisturising and preserving purposes.
Pharma Grade

  * **Product code:** G 86 PH, G 99.8 PH

# PALMERA Fatty Acids
![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/PALMERA-Fatty-Acids01.jpg)
###### Description:
PALMERA Fatty Acids, our range of renewable products obtained from vegetable oils through classical oleochemical production processes including distillation and fractionation. Within this range of products we also offer derivatives such as dimer acids, monomer acids, trimer acids and isostearic acids.
PALMERA Fatty Acids are being applied for beauty and personal care products, lubricants, metal working, paints, inks, crayons, candles, products for Industries & Institutional (I&I) cleaning, herbicides, biocides, plastics, rubber, textiles and detergents.
Manufactured in accordance with legal requirements and quality standards such as GMP+, HACCP and ECOCERT COSMOS, a number of PALMERA Fatty Acids has been made suitable for food, feed, pharmaceutical and personal care applications.
Fractionated Fatty Acids
###### Caproic Acid
  * **Manufacturing Site:** Malaysia, China, Europe
  * **Product code:** A9806, A9906
  * **Applications:** As a flavouring and perfuming agent; Used in production of metalworking fluid to enhance cutting capabilities, grinding capabilities, and rust resistance; Used in production of specialty soaps; As a chain terminator in the production of polyester plasticiser, etc.

  * **Manufacturing Site:** Malaysia, China, Europe

  * **Applications:** Used in the production of various esters, fatty alcohols, fatty acid isethionates, metallic soaps, fatty acid sarcosinates, imidazolines, fatty amines, oxazolines for paint binder, surfactants in cosmetics, liquid and transparent soaps; Used in agricultural chemicals, food, etc.

# TEMEST Esters
![TEMEST Ester 3](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/TEMEST-Ester-3.png)
###### Description:
TEMEST Esters represent KLK OLEO’s comprehensive portfolio of high‑performance ester‑based lubricants designed to meet the evolving needs of modern industries. Developed from renewable raw materials, the TEMEST range delivers exceptional lubricity, oxidative stability, biodegradability, and versatility across applications such as metalworking fluids, hydraulics, gears, compressors, automotive, food‑grade lubricants, and more. From mono esters to advanced polyol and polymeric esters, each product is engineered to enhance efficiency, reduce wear, and support sustainable, reliable performance in demanding operating environments.
Mono Esters
TEMEST Mono Esters are a specialised class of high‑performance ester lubricants, produced through the reaction of a monocarboxylic acid with a monohydric alcohol. Engineered for versatility and reliability, they offer excellent lubricity, stability, and functionality across a wide spectrum of formulations.
At KLK OLEO, we provide a comprehensive portfolio of premium Mono Esters, each meticulously developed to deliver consistent quality and optimised performance for diverse industrial and cosmetic applications.

Polymeric Esters
Polymeric Esters are a specialised class of ester lubricants, characterised by their high molecular weight, typically above ISO 100. KLK OLEO offers a wide range of products, divided into two sub-families: unsaturated and saturated.
These esters can be utilised as base oils (over 85%), co-base stocks (10-50%), or additives (less than 10%) to enhance physical-chemical properties and tribological performance.
When operating in the elasto-hydrodynamic range, they optimise the film layer, resulting in higher energy efficiency and improved overall performance.

TEMEST FC Esters
TEMEST FC is a family of products developed by KLK OLEO to support the formulation of food-grade lubricants for use in food processing and packaging environments. The range offers customers a broad selection of base oils, co-base fluids, and additive components suitable for lubricant formulations intended for incidental food contact (NSF HX-1) and direct food contact (NSF 3H) applications, when formulated and used in accordance with applicable NSF requirements.
As a result, formulations based on TEMEST FC help extend maintenance intervals, reduce cleaning frequency and associated costs, enhance machinery protection, and improve overall energy efficiency, delivering long-term value and operational reliability in demanding food-processing environments. All this while offering a sustainable profile, with high renewability and biodegradability.

# About Us
[Home](https://www.klkoleo.com/) » [Company](https://www.klkoleo.com/company/) » About Us
  

  

  

### About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is one of the world’s leading oleochemical producers committed to delivering excellence in the global marketplace.
Our integrated oleochemicals complexes located in key sourcing and supply markets (Malaysia, Indonesia, China and Europe) produce a wide range of high quality sustainable oleochemical products from natural renewable raw materials.
KLK OLEO is the oleochemicals manufacturing division of [Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (KLK)](https://www.klk.com.my/), a leading international plantations group listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad. Strategically integrated with our upstream plantations parent, KLK OLEO can extract synergies and focus on developing sustainable solutions and reliable supply for our customers. At KLK OLEO, sustainability is integral to our business. We believe that everything we do impacts the entire ecosystem, going beyond just people. Together with our customers and partners, we have the power to create more sustainable products and solutions.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and many more.
We strongly believe in innovation and have a strong focus on research and development. Creating new downstream businesses is central to our strategy of maximising the integrated value chain. KLK OLEO’s approach combines research and industry focus to develop innovative and sustainable products for customers and partners, ensuring performance, quality, and security of supply.
We are proud to be a part of the global oleochemical industry. By focusing on sustainability, quality, operation excellence, people and ethical practices, our vision is growing to be the most trusted global partner in oleo-based products and solutions, thus enriching lives in a sustainable manner every day.
  

  

  

![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2025-RISE-Thumbnail-01.png)
  

  

  
  

  

  

### Our Vision
Growing to be the most trusted global partner in oleo-based products and solutions, thus enriching lives in a sustainable manner every day.
  

### Our Mission
  * **Sustainability**  
Commit to deliver positive impact to climate and people in every possible way.
  * **Quality**  
Consistent delivery of competitive high quality products and solutions that are focused on meeting and exceeding customer expectations.

Value addition through commitment to the highest standards of operational excellence driven by a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
  * **People**  
Cultivating a team that values and develops people of all backgrounds through empowerment and recognition.
  * **Ethical Practices**  
Values built on the legacy of ethical practices embraced by its founder, committed to operate responsibly and with integrity.

  

  

  
  

  

  

### Core Values _T_._H_._R_._I_._I_._L_
  * ###### Teamwork
Going beyond geographical, divisional and functional boundaries to achieve common goals. Collaboration is at the heart of all we do.
  * ###### Humility
Having an open mind to recognise the strength of others and willingness to stretch ourselves and grow.

Committed to exceptional execution and excellence to make a difference in everything we do.

Ethical leadership with a strong moral compass that inspires every individual to do the right thing.

# Corporate Responsibility
[Home](https://www.klkoleo.com/) » Corporate Responsibility
### Values Matter, Society Matters
We are a socially responsible corporate citizen, committed to the communities around where we operate in to deliver a sustainable future.
We believe that corporations are platforms for social change, contributing time and resources to build a better tomorrow.
In achieving these goals, four core elements – Education, Community, Environment and Employee are established as pillars of the Corporate Responsibility initiative. The Corporate Responsibility programmes are designed to help the employees build teamwork, establish engagement, and to nurture them to become responsible corporate citizens.
### Our Commitments

##  Employees
######  Health and Wellbeing 
Employees are one of our greatest assets and their health and wellbeing remain our top priority. We aim to support our employees to be the best they can be by providing them an environment and opportunities that encourage and enable them to lead a healthy lifestyle.

##  Education
######  Empowerment Through Education 
We believe that education is an important catalyst for positive change and transform the future of the community. As such, we seek to create appropriate education inroads and pathways in the areas where we operate for people and communities who may not be fortunate enough to have access to such opportunities.
![Community](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/cr-communityt-01.jpg)

##  Community
######  Care for People 
At KLK, our values and the culture of caring continues through the generations and is embedded in our corporate DNA. In the spirit of caring and sharing, we reach out and engage the less fortunate in various communities. We will endeavor to improve the livelihoods of the communities in areas where we operate.
![Environment](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/cr-environment-01.jpg)

##  Environment
######  Harmony with Nature 
We place great importance on the protection and preservation of the environment and this is reflected in our core business practices and policies. We strongly believe that our livelihoods depend on a healthier, more livable world for us and our future generations.

# History & Milestones
[Home](https://www.klkoleo.com/) » History & Milestones
![1906](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/milestone-1906-square.jpg)
##  1906
The Kuala Lumpur Rubber Company, Limited (KLR) was founded in London to oversee 600 ha. plantations (rubber and coffee) in Malaya (now Malaysia). 
![1960](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/1960-1.jpg)
##  1960
The Group started to plant oil palm in Fraser Estate.
![1973](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/1973.jpg)
##  1973
1st October 1973: Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (KLK) was incorporated in Malaysia and listed publicly on Kuala Lumpur, Singapore and London Stock Exchanges.
![KLK Founder](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/1991-scaled-1.jpg)
##  KLK Founder
The late Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Lee Loy Seng
![1991](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/1991-Founder.png)
##  1991
KLK’s Chief Executive Officer, Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Lee Oi Hian invested in resource-based downstream manufacturing with the opening of its first oleochemical plant, [Palm-Oleo](https://www.klkoleo.com/palm-oleo-sdn-bhd/) in Rawang.  
The birth of KLK OLEO.
![1994](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/milestone-1991-square.jpg)
##  1994
Official Opening of [Palm-Oleo](https://www.klkoleo.com/palm-oleo-sdn-bhd/), officiated by Y.A.B. Dato Seri Dr. Mahathir Mohamad.
![1996](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/milestone-1996-square.jpg)
##  1996
Launching of[ Soap Noodles](https://www.klkoleo.com/palmosalt-soap-download/palmosalt-soap-noodles/) at KSP Manufacturing.
![1997](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/milestone-1997-square.jpg)
##  1997
Introduction of [Ethylene Bis-Stearamide](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmowax-fatty-acid-bis-amides/) and [Alkanolamides](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmocol-alkanolamides/palmocol-alkanolamides/) at Palmamide.
![2004](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/milestone-2004-square.jpg)
##  2004
Greenfield expansion at [Zhangjiagang, China](https://www.klkoleo.com/taiko-palm-oleo-zhangjiagang-co-ltd/), manufacturer of [Fatty Acids](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmera-fatty-acids/), [Glycerine](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmera-glycerine/), [Soap Noodles](https://www.klkoleo.com/palmosalt-soap-download/palmosalt-soap-noodles/) and[ Esters](https://www.klkoleo.com/products/esters/).
![2005](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/2005-Davos.png)
##  2005
Investing in [Davos Life Science Ptd Ltd](https://www.klkoleo.com/davoslife/) in Singapore, manufacturer of phytonutrient from palm fruits.
![2005](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2005-Stolthaven.png)
##  2005
Investing in [Stolthaven (Westport)](https://www.klkoleo.com/stolthavenwestport/) in Malaysia, a storage terminal operator, to optimise the oleochemical supply chain.
![2006](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/2006-Oleomas.png)
##  2006
Introduction of the first fully Malaysian-owned [Fatty Alcohols](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmerol-fatty-alcohols/) plant at[ KL-Kepong Oleomas](https://www.klkoleo.com/kl-kepong-oleomas-sdn-bhd/), Westport, Port Klang.

##  2006
Launching of corporate brand “KLK OLEO”, assembling all oleochemical operations under ONE IDENTITY.
![2007](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/milestone-2007-02-square.jpg)
##  2007
Acquisition of Uniqema Malaysia – renamed as [Palm-Oleo (Klang)](https://www.klkoleo.com/palm-oleo-klang-sdn-bhd/), manufacturer of [Fatty Acids](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmera-fatty-acids/), [Glycerine](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmera-glycerine/), [Esters](https://www.klkoleo.com/products/esters/) and [Soap Noodles](https://www.klkoleo.com/palmosalt-soap-download/palmosalt-soap-noodles/).
![2007](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/milestone-2007-01-square.jpg)
##  2007
Acquisition of [Dr. W.Kolb Holding](https://www.kolb.ch/company/#delden), a large independent alkoxylator and a significant manufacturer and distributor of [Nonionic Surfactants](https://www.klkoleo.com/products/nonionic-surfactants/) and [Esters](https://www.klkoleo.com/products/esters/).
![2009](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/2009.png)
##  2009
Commissioning of Methyl Esters plant at KL-Kepong Oleomas.  
New Oleo-based [Methyl Ester Sulphonate (MES)](https://www.klkoleo.com/?r3d=palmfonate-methyl-ester-sulphonate) introduced at [KL-Kepong Oleomas](https://www.klkoleo.com/kl-kepong-oleomas-sdn-bhd/) as an environment-friendly surfactant.

##  2009
Acquisition of Zoop’s biodiesel plant (renamed as [KLK Bioenergy](https://www.klkoleo.com/klk-bioenergy-sdn-bhd/)).
![2010](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/milestone-2010-square.jpg)
##  2010
Expansion of KLK OLEO’s footprint in Europe through the acquisition of Croda Emmerich, Germany (renamed as [KLK Emmerich](https://www.klkoleo.com/klkemmerich/)).
![2011](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/milestone-2011-square.jpg)
##  2011
Construction of [KLK Dumai](https://www.klkoleo.com/pt-klk-dumai/) facility in Indonesia, further added to the Group’s overall [Fatty Acids](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmera-fatty-acids/) and[ Glycerine](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmera-glycerine/) production capability.
![2012](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/Davoslife-NOV-2015-1LR.jpg)
##  2012
Relocation of[ Davos Life Science](https://www.klkoleo.com/davoslife/)’s operation at Singapore to Westport, Malaysia, and with expansion of production capacity.

###  KLK OLEO  Secara Singkat
KLK OLEO adalah salah satu produsen oleokimia terkemuka di dunia yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan produk terbaik di pasar global. Kawasan oleokimia kami yang terintegrasi berlokasi di pasar yang memiliki sumber daya dan pemasok utama (Malaysia, Indonesia, Tiongkok, Amerika dan Eropa) dalam membuat berbagai macam produk oleokimia dengan kualitas tinggi dan berkelanjutan dari bahan baku alami yang terbarukan.
KLK OLEO adalah bagian dari Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”), sebuah kelompok perkebunan internasional yang terdaftar di Pasar Utama Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad. Berlokasi secara strategis dan terintegrasi dengan induk perkebunan kami, KLK OLEO mampu mengekstraksi sinergi dan berfokus pada solusi pembangunan berkelanjutan serta menjadi produsen yang dapat diandalkan oleh pelanggan kami.
Portofolio produksi KLK OLEO berkisar dari produk oleokimia dasar, _fatty acids, glycerine, fatty alcohols dan fatty esters_ , hingga produk khusus, seperti _methyl ester sulphonate (MES), surfactants dan phytonutrients_. Produk kami digunakan dalam berbagai macam aplikasi penggunaan akhir, termasuk perawatan kesehatan rumah dan pribadi, kosmetik & perlengkapan mandi, makanan, rasa & wewangian, pelumas, polimer, dan bahan kimia industri. Didukung oleh keyakinan yang kuat dalam berinovasi dan kekuatan budaya R&D, penciptaan hilirisasi bisnis baru terus menjadi landasan strategi kami untuk memanfaatkan rantai nilai terintegrasi.
* * *
Jaringan KLK OLEO telah berada di 9 negara berbeda di seluruh dunia dengan tenaga kerja lebih dari 3.000 karyawan secara global. Seiring dengan berkembangnya bisnis kami, maka kami percaya bahwa karyawan adalah aset terpenting bagi keberlanjutan dan pertumbuhan bisnis jangka panjang kami; oleh karena itu, kami terus mencari talenta terbaik untuk bergabung menjadi tenaga kerja di perusahaan kami.
Berkarier bersama KLK OLEO berarti Anda menjadi bagian dari hal yang istimewa di perusahaan kami. Dengan mengusung Visi dan Nilai Perusahaan, karyawan melaksanakan Misi kami untuk meningkatkan taraf hidup dan memberikan hasil bisnis yang lebih kuat dan efektif. Melalui kerangka kerja pengembangan dan kompetensi karyawan, kami yakin dapat meningkatkan kinerja karyawan dengan cara terbaik dan mendukung kesinambungan rencana bisnis.
Kami mencari talenta yang memiliki semangat, energi, antusiasme; dan yang lebih penting, selaras dengan Nilai Utama kami yang terdiri dari _**T** eamwork, **H** umility, **R** esults, **I** ntegrity, **I** nnovation and **L** oyalty._ Bergabunglah dan menjadi bagian dari tim kami, dan kami akan membantu mengembangkan potensi Anda secara penuh.

# KL-Kepong Oleomas Sdn. Bhd.
[Home](https://www.klkoleo.com/) » KL-Kepong Oleomas Sdn. Bhd.
As one the world’s largest producers of natural Fatty Alcohols, KL-Kepong Oleomas (“KLKOM”) produces a wide variety of high quality oleochemical products.
KLKOM’s key products are [PALMEROL Fatty Alcohols](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmerol-fatty-alcohols/), [PALMERE Fractionated Methyl Esters](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmere-methyl-esters/) and [PALMFONATE Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES)](https://www.klkoleo.com/?r3d=palmfonate-methyl-ester-sulphonate). They are 100% vegetable oil based and produced from readily renewable and sustainable natural resources.
[PALMEROL Fatty Alcohols](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmerol-fatty-alcohols/) are widely used as emulsifying, dispersing, wetting agents or surfactants. C12 to C18 alcohols provide starting materials for all surfactant types. [PALMERE Fractionated Methyl Esters](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmere-methyl-esters/) are mainly employed as intermediates for chemical synthesis and used as fuel bio-additives. [PALMFONATE MES](https://www.klkoleo.com/?r3d=palmfonate-methyl-ester-sulphonate) is the main ingredient in powder or liquid detergents. The newly launched [SYMPARE MES](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/sympare-methyl-ester-sulphonates/) is a sulphate-free cleaning agent for use in the personal care categories. [SYMPARE MES](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/sympare-methyl-ester-sulphonates/) is listed in the CleanGredients database as it meets the EPA’s Safer Choice Standard.
In 2021, KLKOM has successfully added [TENSOPOL Sodium Lauryl Sulphate (“SLS”)](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/tensopol-alcohol-sulphates/) and [TENSAGEX Sodium Lauryl Ether Sulphate (“SLES”)](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/tensagex-alcohol-ether-sulphates/) into their product portfolio as primary surfactants home and personal care industries.
KLKOM’s manufacturing plant is strategically located at Westport, Malaysia, allowing direct pipeline access from the plant to the port, for fast and effective supply and distribution to international markets.

# Celebrating 100 Years of Excellence in Delden
10 Jun 2026
For a full century, the site along the Langestraat has been a familiar landmark for anyone passing through this corner of Twente. The chimney that once bore the name Servo is long gone, but the chemical company behind it, today known as KLK Kolb Specialties B.V., part of KLK OLEO Surfactants, remains deeply woven into the fabric of the region. A centenary worth celebrating.
The seven-hectare site is a world of its own. Laboratories, research facilities and towering reactors holding tens of thousands of litres operate virtually without pause, the only exception being public holidays. Visitors quickly learn the rules: beyond a clearly marked yellow line, only specially approved mobile phones are permitted. Safety is non-negotiable in this industry.
**From Delden into Every Home**  
The plant does not manufacture finished consumer products. Instead, it produces surfactants, which are surface-active agents that allow oil and water to mix, or make substances soluble that would otherwise refuse to dissolve. These chemical building blocks end up in shampoos, laundry detergents, wall paints and textiles. In other words, there is a good chance something made in Delden is sitting in your home right now.
**From a Steam Laundry to a Global Group**  
The story begins in 1926, when two local entrepreneurs, Kuiper and Rozenbroek, set up shop in a disused steam laundry after their original plan to build in Enschede fell through. They served the Twente textile industry, and during the Second World War even pivoted to food production when circumstances demanded it.
Decades of growth, restructuring and ownership changes followed. Locally the site is still affectionately called Servo, even though that name was officially retired in 2000 and the iconic chimney demolished in 2018. Today the company is owned by Swiss-based Kolb Distribution Ltd., itself part of KLK OLEO, the oleochemical arm of Malaysian conglomerate Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad.
**More Than Just a Factory**  
The site is unusually well-equipped for an industrial location. It has its own volunteer fire brigade, a dedicated wastewater treatment plant, and most remarkably, a private railway spur that branches off the Zutphen–Oldenzaal line and runs directly onto the premises. Freight trains have used this connection for decades to deliver raw materials straight to the factory floor.
The railway has not always run without incident. In the early 1980s a wrongly set switch accidentally directed a passenger train onto the site. It was stopped in time, nobody was hurt, and the story has since become part of company folklore.
**Three Generations, Fifty-Year Careers**  
Walk through the site with a long-serving colleague and you quickly sense that this is more than just a workplace. Over 200 people are employed here, the vast majority from Delden and the wider Twente area, with many of them cycling in each morning. Staff turnover is remarkably low: three employees recently marked 40 years of service, and last year one colleague reached 50. There are families where three generations have worked on the same site, and farmers’ sons who once looked for a temporary job and never left. That kind of loyalty speaks for itself.
**Centenary Celebrations**  
The anniversary programme ran across several days. A business reception took place on Thursday 30 April, followed on Friday 1 May by a gathering for retirees and former staff, with dignitaries including the mayor, a provincial executive and the Count of Twickel in attendance, and an evening party for current employees.
On Saturday 2 May, the site opened its doors to the general public. As production continues around the clock and safety rules are strict, visitors were guided around the grounds by bus. The programme included live demonstrations by the company fire brigade and a kids’ science lab.
**From a small chemical supplier for the local textile industry to a global player in specialty chemistry; one hundred years of growth, resilience and community. The story of KLK Kolb Specialties is far from over, and the next hundred years have already begun.**
![KLK Kolb 100 Years Anniversary](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/KLK-Kolb-100-Years-Anniversary.png)

# Commander of the Order of Leopold II Award
30 Aug 2021
The King of Belgium has conferred upon the CEO of [Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”)](http://www.klk.com.my/) Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Lee Oi Hian the Commander of the Order of Leopold II during a private ceremony on 26 August 2021.
The prestigious National Order was officially presented to Tan Sri Lee on behalf of King Philippe of the Belgians by the Ambassador of Belgium to Malaysia His Excellency Pascal Grégoire. This award is given in honour of [KLK Tensachem’](https://tensachem.com/)s (part of KLK OLEO) transformation and contribution to the Sovereign of Belgium.
![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/KLKs-CEO-Tan-Sri-Dato-Seri-Lee-Oi-Hian-awarded-the-Commander-of-the-Order-of-Leopold-II.jpg)Tan Sri Lee giving his acceptance speech and looking on is Belgium Ambassador to Malaysia H.E. Pascal Grégoire
This Order, which was established on 24 August 1900, is awarded for meritorious service to the Sovereign of Belgium by Royal Decree, as a token of His personal goodwill. According to Mr Ambassador Grégoire, the Order is roughly equivalent to the British Victorian Order, which is a personal gift as well of the British monarch and has similar cases.
![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/KLK-Tensachem.jpg)An ariel view of KLK Tensachem S.A. production site in Ougrée, Belgium
It was an honour to have other dignitaries to witness the momentous occasion. Also present at the ceremony was newly appointed Ambassador of Malaysia to Belgium H.E. Dato’ Ahmad Rozian Abd Ghani, Ambassador of the European Union to Malaysia H.E. Mr Michalis Rokas, Berjaya’s Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Vincent Tan and Belgium Embassy’s Deputy Head of Mission Mr Pierrick Massaux. The KLK OLEO team was represented by KLK OLEO CEO Mr Madhev Bala Subramaniam, Managing Director FAL & ME SBU Mr Raghunathan Nair and Managing Director MES Mr Chua Boon Hook.
![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/Group1.jpg)Above from L-R: Ambassador of Malaysia to Belgium H.E. Dato’ Ahmad Rozian Abd Ghani, Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian, Tan Sri Vincent Tan, Belgium Ambassador H.E. Mr. Pascal Grégoire and Ambassador of the European Union to Malaysia H.E. Mr Michalis Rokas.

# Davos Life Science achieves FSSC 22000 certification, demonstrating unwavering commitment to food safety excellence
23 Jan 2024
![DavosLife E3 full range FSSC 22000 Certification](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/DavosLife-E3-full-range-FSSC-22000-01.png)
Davos Life Science is proud to announce our achievement in the Food Safety System Certification 22000 (FSSC 22000). This achievement signifies our unwavering commitment to delivering the highest standards of food safety to our customers.
FSSC 22000 is an ISO-based food safety management scheme recognised by the Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI), it meets the highest standards globally, leading to international food industry acceptance.
This certification not only benefits our customers by guaranteeing the safety and quality of Davos Life Science products, but also reinforces the company’s position as a trusted leader in the industry.
Davos Life Science is proud of this accomplishment and remains committed to exceeding industry standards in food safety. We will continue to invest in our food safety management system and strive to deliver the highest quality products to our customers every time.
**About Davos Life Science**  
[Davos Life Science](https://www.klkoleo.com/davoslife/) is one of the leading market players in producing high quality Tocotrienols and Mixed Carotenes from non-GMO palm fruits, sourced directly from RSPO-certified plantations. Tocotrienols have 60x more antioxidative potency compared to α-tocopherol with strong anti-inflammatory properties. DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols are bioactive ingredients for dietary supplements, functional food and beverages, cosmetic and personal care products.
Davos Life Science is part of KLK OLEO, the Oleochemical Division of [Kuala Lumpur-Kepong Berhad (KLK)](https://www.klk.com.my/).

# Davos Life Science & ColorNet: Transforming Brazil’s Skincare Future with the Power of Tocotrienols
24 Sep 2026
![Davos Life Science & ColorNet Partnership: Transforming Brazil’s Skincare Future with the Power of Tocotrienols](https://www.klkoleo.com/davoslife/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Davos-ColorNet-Partnership-incosLatam.jpg)
Davos Life Science Sdn. Bhd. as part of KLK OLEO Group, a global leader in natural palm-derived Tocotrienols, and ColorNet, a leading distributor serving Brazil’s beauty and personal care industry, are pleased to announce a strategic partnership to expand the availability of DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols in the Brazilian skincare market.
The partnership marks an important milestone for both organisations as ColorNet becomes Davos Life Science’s authorised distributor for the personal care segment in Brazil. Through this collaboration, both companies aim to introduce scientifically backed Tocotrienols solutions to cosmetic manufacturers and brand owners seeking innovative ingredients for skin health and beauty applications.
**Reveal Natural Radiance. Restore Youthful Luminosity.**
DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols — the “Extraordinary Super Vitamin E” — act on skin through three complementary mechanisms: potent antioxidant activity, powerful anti-inflammatory action, and gene modulation. This triple mode of action is documented across an extensive body of peer-reviewed research covering anti-ageing, skin brightening, blue light and pollution defence, and skin barrier support.
**Clinically demonstrated in human studies**
  * Reduces UV-induced skin redness by up to 26%
  * Reduces UV-induced tanning by up to 32%

**Science Proven Multi-Pathway Benefits from published studies**
  1.     1. _Combats Oxidative stress_ — reduces DNA, lipid and protein oxidation markers: 8-OHdG by up to 66%, malondialdehyde by 44%, and protein carbonyl by 58%.  
Benefits: Helps protect skin from premature ageing, and promotes healthier, more resilient skin.
    2. _Inflammatory response Calms Inflammation & Skin Irritation_ — downregulates key mediators: IL-6 by up to 64%, IL-8 by 72%, and COX-2 by 47%.  
Benefits: Helps soothe redness and sensitivity, supports faster skin recovery, improves overall skin comfort.
    3. _Reduces Hyperpigmentation, Brightens Skin Tone Pigmentation_ — suppresses tyrosinase expression, reducing melanin production by up to 55%.  
Benefits: Helps minimise dark spots and uneven pigmentation, promotes brighter and more radiant skin, and supports a more uniform skin tone.
    4. _Defends Against Pollution-Induced Skin Damage Pollution defence and barrier integrity_ — suppresses PM2.5-induced MAPK signalling, downregulating phosphorylation of p38 by 61%, JNK1/2 by 70% and ERK by 24%. Also protects cells from mitochondria-mediated apoptosis. Under the same conditions, alpha-tocopherol showed no strong inhibitory effect.  
Benefits: Strengthens the skin barrier against urban pollution, helps prevent environmental ageing, enhances skin resilience, reduces visible signs of stress caused by external aggressors, and supports long-term skin vitality.

[Learn more](https://www.klkoleo.com/skin-care/) about the full skincare benefits of DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols.
**Key Consumer Takeaway**
Tocotrienols deliver clinically proven protection against the four major drivers of skin ageing: oxidative stress, inflammation, hyperpigmentation, and environmental pollution, resulting in healthier, brighter, younger-looking, and more resilient skin.
**Sustainably Sourced. Fully Traceable.**
DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols are sourced from sustainably managed palm plantations within the Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”) Group, the parent company of Davos Life Science, ensuring full supply chain traceability, consistent batch-to-batch quality, and reliable long-term supply security.
Davos Life Science, a subsidiary of Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (KLK), a leading diversified resource-based manufacturing and international plantation group, is a global producer of high-quality natural phytonutrients. The company specialises in DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols, the extraordinary full-spectrum vitamin E complex comprising of natural Tocotrienols and tocopherol, as well as DavosLife Biocarotene, the Natural Mixed Carotenes. Supported by KLK’s vertically integrated plantation operations and its resource manufacturing division, KLK OLEO, Davos Life Science ensures a sustainable and reliable supply of premium natural phytonutrients to the global market.
As a leader in specialty ingredients and chemicals, ColorNet is uniquely positioned to accelerate the adoption of premium bioactive ingredients in Brazil. By connecting innovative global technologies with local market opportunities, and drawing on its deep expertise in specialty ingredients, chemicals, skincare, and personal care, ColorNet serves as a strategic partner in bringing scientifically validated, high-efficacy bioactive solutions to market. Together, we can shape the future of performance-driven, innovation-led beauty and personal care products.

# First rooftop solar photovoltaics system in KLK OLEO
17 May 2023
Electricity is a key element in KLK OLEO’s manufacturing process and contributes significantly to process costs and greenhouse gas emissions. In 2022, the Group decided to invest in a rooftop solar photovoltaic (PV) system at Palm-Oleo (Klang) Sdn Bhd (POK). The solar PV system produces electricity that is environmentally friendly and sustainable by harnessing the sun’s energy.
A total of 1,576 monocrystalline solar PV modules were installed on available rooftops, including warehouses, loading bays and offices. Through the installation, POK can generate 1 GWh of renewable energy each year, about 5% of its electricity usage.
This system is one of KLK OLEO’s increased efforts to reducing greenhouse gas emissions and achieving Net Zero.

# Fuel Smarter with Sustainable MCT

# PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT Oil and Powder  

Sourced from renewable natural ingredients, **PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT** delivers efficient energy in both oil and powder forms. Its 6–12 carbon chain structure allows for rapid absorption and quick energy release. The oil is neutral in taste, colourless, and odourless—ideal for functional food and beverage formulations. The powder offers versatility for meal replacements, active nutrition, and wellness products. Whether for performance or everyday vitality, **PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT** drives innovation across today’s nutrition landscape.
## Supporting Health Through Functional Nutrition  

With a metabolic pathway distinct from long-chain fats in the human body, **PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT** delivers quick energy, supports weight management, and fits well into ketogenic and digestive-friendly diets.
## Versatile Applications Across Food Innovation  

**PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT** enhances nutritional value and product functionality across diverse applications, from indulgent spreads to next-generation meat alternatives, helping formulators achieve the ideal balance of health, taste, and performance.
In Sauces and Dressings, it enables up to 40% fat substitution without the need for reformulation, delivering ideal texture, sensory appeal, and storage stability.
In Plant-based Meat, it improves chewiness and elasticity, supports oxidative stability, offers potential for full fat replacement, and helps reduce calories by up to 18%.
MCT is a flexible ingredient that fits easily into a wide range of food and beverage formats, supporting both everyday and emerging health-focused innovations.
KLK OLEO offers **PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT** oil in various grades, while MCT powders are available in different oil loadings to suit specific formulation needs.

# KLK awarded Malaysia’s Best Managed Companies for third consecutive year
20 Sep 2024
![KLK Malaysia’s Best Managed Companies in 2024 Collage](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Collage.jpg)
KLK has once again been recognised as one of Malaysia’s Best Managed Companies in 2024. This marks the third consecutive year we have received this honour, reflecting our Company’s organisational success and contributions to the industry. The awards ceremony took place on 22 August, at Le Meridien Kuala Lumpur.
This year was particularly special, as KLK’s Executive Chairman, Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian was invited to be a guest speaker to share his insights on “Empowering the Next Generation for Business.”
Tan Sri Lee paid tribute to his father, the late Founder Chairman Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng, during his speech. He shared his experience as a second-generation leader and how he continued to build upon his father’s legacy. Additionally, he highlighted Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng’s subtle yet impactful mentorship and shared three valuable lessons:
  1. **Core** **Values** : “Integrity, humility, loyalty.” Values that Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng lived by, which continue to guide KLK’s dominant culture of **T**.**H**.**R**.**I**.**I**.**L**.
  2. **Purpose** **in** **life** : Finding fulfilment in life goes beyond wealth. It’s about creating a compassionate environment that impacts KLK’s 50,000 employees and their families. Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng reminded us to be good stewards of our stakeholders. Fulfilling this stewardship brings true contentment to life.
  3. **Balancing** **work** **and** **family** : His ability to manage the demands of running a business while fostering family unity and solidarity.

KLK’s COO, Mr. Lee Jia Zhang, accepted the award on behalf of KLK. Ms. Lee Wen Ling, Managing Director of KLK Land, was also invited onstage to answer a few questions about the win.
When asked about the perception of the plantation industry as being part of the “old economy,” Ms. Lee responded: “I believe this view is inaccurate. As consumers become more conscious, there is a growing demand for sustainably produced products. To stay ahead, we must continue exploring and adapting, going beyond sustainability certifications to focus on areas like decarbonisation and traceability, among others.”
Also present at the award gala dinner were KLK Head of Corporate Mr. Teh Kwan Wey and Sustainability & Special Projects AGM Mr. Adrian Tan.

![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Ralf-Ewering-300x300.jpg)
KLK OLEO announces today the appointment of Ralf Ewering as Chief Sustainability Officer Europe.
Ralf will drive and lead the development and delivery of the Europe region’s sustainability strategy to further establish KLK OLEO’s sustainability leadership in the Oleochemical industry.
“I’m excited to further drive momentum to KLK OLEO’s sustainability journey and work on the positive transition of our industry towards the people and our planet.” Ralf Ewering said.
Ralf has 27 years of experience in different managerial positions in the process industry and is working for 17 years in the oleochemical industry. Ralf holds a Master in Chemical Engineering from the Technical University of Dortmund.
At KLK OLEO, our principles on sustainability are guided by integrity. # KLK OLEO Expands Business Footprint to the Americas
01 Mar 2021
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer with production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as[ fatty acids](https://www.klkoleo.com/products/fatty-acids/), [glycerine](https://www.klkoleo.com/?products=gycerine), [fatty alcohols](https://www.klkoleo.com/products/fatty-alcohols/) and [fatty esters](https://www.klkoleo.com/products/esters/), all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as [methyl ester sulphonate (MES)](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmfonate-methyl-ester-sulphonate/), [surfactants](https://www.klkoleo.com/products/nonionic-surfactants/) and [phytonutrients](https://www.klkoleo.com/products/phytonutrients/). KLK OLEO products are used in diverse end-use applications, including [home](https://www.klkoleo.com/markets/home-care-industries-institutional-ii-cleaning/) &[ personal care](https://www.klkoleo.com/markets/beauty-personal-care/), pharmaceuticals, [food & nutrition](https://www.klkoleo.com/markets/food-nutrition/), flavours & fragrances, [lubricants](https://www.klkoleo.com/markets/lubricants/), [polymers](https://www.klkoleo.com/markets/polymers/) and industrial chemicals.
KLK OLEO just expanded its business footprint to the Americas with a new sales office at Woodbury, NY, USA. KLK OLEO Americas (KLKOA) will oversee the sales and marketing in the United States, Canada and South America. And continuously maintain and build customer relationships for the KLK OLEO group product portfolio.
KLKOA will create a local distribution network through storage locations across the US for packed and bulk materials to serve the customers in the Americas region with just-in-time deliveries.
As a leader in quality, sustainability, and renewable ingredients worldwide, KLK OLEO is every formulator’s answer to creating sustainable products.

# KLK OLEO planted 200 Trees at Lower Kinabatangan Wildlife Sanctuary
08 Jul 2023
In line with our sustainability commitment and in conjunction with the Palm & Lauric Price Outlook Conference (POC), KLK OLEO partnered with APE Malaysia (Animal Projects & Environmental Education Sdn. Bhd.) and planted 200 trees in the lower Kinabatangan River Wildlife Sanctuary in Sabah, Malaysia. These trees are to reconnect the forest corridors that serve as habitats for endangered animals.
The following trees were planted on plot 05°27’20.56″ E118°14’24.37″.  
| Tree Species  | Number of Trees  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Bangkal _(Neonauclea subdita)_  | 66  |  
| Talisai Paya _(Terminalia copelandii)_  | 36  |  
| Medang 3 Urat _(Cinamomom sp)_  | 10  |  
| Fig _(Ficus sp)_  | 9  |  
| Lamba _(Colona seratifolia)_  | 6  |  
| Simpoh Laki _(Dillenia excelsa)_  | 30  |  
| Obah Jangkang _(Eugenia cerassiformis)_  | 1  |  
| Tangkol Merah _(Ficus sp)_  | 1  |  
| Pulai _(Alstonia sp)_  | 3  |  
| Medang _(Litsea sp)_  | 2  |  
| Bayor _(Pterospermum elongatum)_  | 36  |  
| **TOTAL**  | **200**  |  
These trees will reach 5m in height in just 5 years and will converge with the rest of the trees to form the forest canopy in less than 10 years. We hope to hear gibbons and birds singing, monkeys swinging from tree to tree, and possibly an orangutan nesting high in the trees!
APE will provide updates on its reforestation site on their social media platforms, including [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/ApeMalaysia),[ Twitter](https://twitter.com/ApeMalaysia), [Instagram](https://instagram.com/apemalaysia) or [Youtube](https://www.youtube.com/user/ApeMalaysia).
![KLK OLEO for POC 2023 Certificate](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/KLK-Oleo-for-POC-2023-Certificate.png)
**Plant more trees to keep the Earth healthy. Save the environment to save your future.**

# KLK OLEO invites you to Vitafoods Virtual Expo
18 Aug 2020
VitaFoods Europe is the leading nutraceutical event of the year, connecting health and nutrition business leaders throughout the entire supply chain. At this year’s VitaFoods Virtual Expo,[ **Davos Life Science**](https://www.klkoleo.com/davoslife/) will be highlighting a potential new application of Tocotrienols as a bioactive to protect the body from pollution-induced oxidative stress and low-grade chronic inflammation.
Research studies have shown that prolonged exposure to environmental air pollution can increase morbidity and mortality. Air pollution induces oxidative stress in skin, lung, vascular and heart tissue, triggering redox-sensitive pathways that lead to biological processes like inflammation and cell death.
[**Davos Life Science**](https://www.klkoleo.com/davoslife/) will showcase new research data demonstrating how Tocotrienols can reduce oxidative stress and inflammation markers, alongside practical demonstrations of how Tocotrienols can be incorporated into functional foods and beverages, to emphasise the applicability of Tocotrienols as a bioactive for anti-pollution. This will drive product differentiation for businesses to help them answer a growing consumer need.
Our sales representatives, **Mr. Jimmy Yow** and **Dr. Sharon Ling** will be available for pre-scheduled online meetings (via Vitafoods Virtual Expo platform) throughout **7 to 11 September 2020** , so book a slot to talk to them about how Tocotrienols can be incorporated into anti-pollution formulations.
We look forward to connect with you!
[![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/KLK-OLEO-e-invite-to-Vitafoods-Virtual-Expo-2020_Final.jpg)](https://registration.gesevent.com/survey/1c4fg0okeua6a)

# KLK OLEO Received “Thriving in Adversity” Award at Export Excellence Awards (EEA) 2022

KLK OLEO received the “Thriving in Adversity” Award at the Export Excellence Awards (EEA) Gala Night held on 25th November 2022 at M Resort and Hotel in Kuala Lumpur.
Organised by The Star Media Group, EEA celebrates “the best of the best” in the export world. It honours the excellence of homegrown businesses in export and targets to build a community of Malaysian exporters that excels through healthy competition and support of one another.
The award was accepted by Mr. Siew Fook Ming, Deputy CEO, on behalf of KLK OLEO. The award honours KLK OLEO’s efforts and tremendous resilience while navigating global headwinds and demonstrating excellence by thriving in adversity during the Covid-19 crisis.
![KLK OLEO EEA Stage](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/KLK-OLEO-EEA-Stage.png)
During the peak of Covid-19 pandemic, KLK OLEO as an approved essential industry, sustained efforts to maintain operations on units of demand, without compromising the health and wellbeing of the staffs – an invaluable asset. It clustered as a unified team, exercising multiple controls in curbing the spread of Covid-19, while operating on key areas of demand. A Covid-19 task force comprising senior management, working closely with its people, was formed across all its sites.
This award will prove as a catalyst for KLK OLEO to continue excelling in the Malaysian palm oil and oleochemical industry.

# New Surfactants from KLKOM’s Sulphation Plants
05 Apr 2021
[KL-Kepong Oleomas Sdn Bhd (“KLKOM”)](https://www.klkoleo.com/kl-kepong-oleomas-sdn-bhd/) has successfully added [Sodium Lauryl Sulphate (“SLS”)](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/tensopol-alcohol-sulphates/) and[ Sodium Lauryl Ether Sulphate (“SLES”)](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/tensagex-alcohol-ether-sulphates/) into their product portfolio since the first quarter (Q1) of 2021. KLKOM is the second SLS and SLES production site of KLK OLEO group after [KLK Tensachem, Belgium](https://tensachem.com/). The SLS and SLES manufactured by KLKOM are GMP-certified.
The addition of these two products makes the offering from KLK OLEO in Asia more complete, especially in the home and personal care industry.
###### [Sodium Lauryl Sulphate (TENSOPOL SLS)](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/tensopol-alcohol-sulphates/)
KLK OLEO produces [TENSOPOL SLS](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/tensopol-alcohol-sulphates/) with 100% renewable carbon. It is biodegradable, does not bio-accumulate in water or land, and has a natural origin index of 0.9 in accordance with ISO 16128. KLKOM can produce SLS in the form of needles, powder, as well as liquid.
SLS is one of the primary surfactants widely used in oral care, personal care and home care. SLS is also an effective surfactant used extensively in industrial applications to make floor cleaners, engine degreasers and machine wash detergents. Toothpaste can also use SLS in a lower concentration.
![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/news-n-events-sls-sles-img01.jpg)
###### [Sodium Lauryl Ether Sulphate (TENSAGEX SLES)](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/tensagex-alcohol-ether-sulphates/)
SLES is an anionic surfactant, widely used as a primary surfactant in rinse-off products, such as dishwashing liquid and shampoo.
Produced from natural fatty alcohols, [TENSAGEX SLES](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/tensagex-alcohol-ether-sulphates/) features very high purity and low in 1,4-dioxane, salt and colour. It meets the latest regulatory restrictions for household cleaning products and personal care products.
[TENSAGEX SLES](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/tensagex-alcohol-ether-sulphates/) is available as a high-active paste and also in the form of low active liquid for easy processing.
![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/news-n-events-sls-sles-img02.jpg)
With state-of-the-art technology to be completed at the end of 2021, SLES with 1 moles EO produced from KLKOM could achieve 1,4 dioxane specs at 5ppm max, which is one of the most stringent specs in the industry.

# Palm-Oleo Awarded MSOSH Gold Class I Award
27 Dec 2022
[Palm-Oleo Sdn Bhd (Palm-Oleo)](https://www.klkoleo.com/palm-oleo-sdn-bhd/) Fatty Acid & Glycerine (FAG) Plant and Soap Noodle & Amide (SNAM) Plant were both awarded the MSOSH Gold Class I Award. On 21st December 2022, the Malaysian Society of Occupational Safety & Health (MSOSH) held the spectacular event at the Sunway Resort Hotel. Both plant delegations were led by their respective General Managers, Dr. Liew Weng Hui and Ms. Lim Fong Nee.
While FAG Plant has achieved this feat for the second year in a row, it is significant this year that SNAM Plant has participated and stands tall together to represent KLK OLEO in an event attended by other leading oil and gas, utility, and chemical producer companies in Malaysia.

The primary goal of Palm-Oleo’s participation in this yearly event is to assess and improve the current level of occupational safety and health standards, practises, and culture at Palm-Oleo. As a result, we can rest assured that Palm-Oleo is currently on the right path toward SHE excellence.
This recognition is in line with KLK Group’s aim to continuously practice and support the Group’s safety & health programme to ensure a better and safer workplace for all.
![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/IMG20221221122154.jpg)Palm-Oleo team posing with both Gold Class I plaques & trophies

# Press Release: KLK OLEO to acquire Italy-based Temix Oleo
28 Feb 2023
Acquisition will expand KLK OLEOs’ product offering for Oleochemical.
Milan, Italy and Emmerich, Germany – Temix Oleo SpA (“Temix Oleo”) and KLK Emmerich GmbH (“KLKE”), a subsidiary of [Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”)](https://www.klk.com.my/), under its resource-based manufacturing division known as KLK OLEO, has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire a controlling stake in Temix Oleo (“the Transaction”).
KLK OLEO is a global integrated oleochemical producer (oleochemical, derivatives and specialty chemicals) with manufacturing sites in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of KLK, a leading international plantations group listed on the Malaysia stock exchange with a market capitalisation of approximately Euro 4.8 billion as at the end of September 2022.
Temix Oleo is an oleochemical company focused on production of Esters mainly based on renewable feed stocks, and delivering solutions for lubricant, cosmetic, ceramic, coating, rubber and plastics industries.
Temix Oleo is located in Milan, Italy with production plant in Calderara di Reno (Bologna) employing around 100 people with a turnover of Euro 150 million in 2022.
The Transaction is expected to be completed by April 2023, subject to regulatory approval and customary closing conditions.
“Temix Oleo outstanding reputation is built on their customer-centric and high-quality service business model. We are excited to welcome the Temix Oleo team and their excellent product portfolio to be part of the group of KLK (“KLK Group”)” said Sriganesh Mathur Subramanian, Managing Director, KLKE.
“This acquisition is an opportunity for Temix Oleo to continue to grow, in product portfolio and geographic areas, with focus on sustainability and innovation. Being part of the KLK Group, employees can look forward to a bright future.“ said Roberto Cella, Managing Director Temix Oleo.
For more information, please visit [www.klkoleo.com/klkemmerich](https://www.klkoleo.com/klkemmerich/en/) and [www.temixoleo.com](https://www.temixoleo.com/)
![KLK OLEO acquires Italian ester producer Temix Oleo](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/KLK-OLEO-acquires-Italian-ester-producer-Temix-Oleo.png)KLK OLEO to acquire Italian Ester Producer Temix Oleo

# Press Release: KLK renews support to Malaysian Mixed Doubles Stars Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai
07 Jan 2025
[Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](https://www.klk.com.my/) (“KLK” or the “Group”) is proud to announce the renewal of our sponsorship for Malaysia’s national badminton mixed doubles pair, Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai, through 2025. This renewal reflects KLK’s continued commitment to support local sporting talent and fostering national pride.
Since 2023, KLK has been a proud supporter of the pair, who have made remarkable strides on the international stage. In addition to renewing their sponsorship, KLK has extended support to their coach, Teo Kok Siang, ensuring the team has the resources to excel in the coming year.
As part of this partnership, Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai will also serve as KLK Brand Ambassadors for DavosLife Science products, including DavosLife E3 Complete Tocotrienols and Revive Skin Care BeauE Collagen.
Commenting on the partnership, KLK Chief Operating Officer, Lee Jia Zhang said, “We are incredibly proud of Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai for their dedication and outstanding performance over the past year. Their perseverance and sportsmanship are inspiring and we wish them the very best as they compete in the upcoming PETRONAS Malaysia Open and the 2025 season.”
Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai expressed their heartfelt gratitude for KLK’s continued support, saying “Our journey as independent players has been challenging, yet incredibly rewarding. Securing funding and meeting our tournament commitments has been a significant hurdle. KLK’s unwavering trust in our potential, regardless of outcomes, has been empowering. This partnership has not only boosted our confidence but has also provided us the stability to focus on our performance and represent Malaysia with pride.”
Looking ahead, the duo shared their ambitious goals: “Our immediate target for the PETRONAS Malaysia Open is to advance to the quarterfinals. Beyond that, we aim to refine our performance, maintain consistency and break into the world’s top five rankings. In 2024, we came close to securing a Super 1000 championship title in China but narrowly missed it. For 2025 we are motivated to achieve that milestone.”
KLK looks forward to celebrate more milestones with Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai as they continue to thrive and make Malaysia proud in the 2025 season.
![Press Release: KLK renews support to Malaysian Mixed Doubles Stars Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/DSC_3698.jpg)KLK Chief Operating Officer Mr. Lee Jia Zhang (centre) with Shevon Lai (left) and Goh Soon Huat (right) at the signing ceremony recently
Also featured in [The Star.](https://www.thestar.com.my/metro/metro-news/2025/01/16/corporation-renews-support-for-shuttlers-soon-huat-shevon)
