# Press Release: KLK OLEO completes acquisition of Temix Oleo
15 Apr 2023
**Acquisition expands KLK OLEO’s product offering for Oleochemicals**
[KLK Emmerich GmbH (“KLKE”)](https://www.klkoleo.com/klkemmerich/en/) a subsidiary of [Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”)](https://www.klk.com.my/), under its resource-based manufacturing division known as KLK OLEO, has recently completed its acquisition of a controlling stake in [Temix Oleo SpA (“Temix Oleo”)](https://www.temixoleo.com/) for an undisclosed sum. The transaction was completed after receiving all necessary approvals and fulfilling all customary closing conditions.
“We are thrilled to have completed this acquisition and to welcome the talented team from Temix Oleo to the KLK group. This acquisition is aligned with our long-term strategy and vision for growth by further diversifying our product offering, increasing access to key customers and augmenting our product specialisation strategy across our European operations,” said Uwe Halder, CEO, KLK OLEO Europe.
“We are excited to join forces with KLK OLEO and bring our unique capabilities and expertise to the table. We are confident that this merger will be beneficial for all parties involved and will create new opportunities for growth and innovation,” said Roberto Cella, Managing Director of Temix Oleo.
KLK OLEO is a global integrated oleochemical producer (oleochemical, derivatives and specialty chemicals) with manufacturing sites in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of KLK, a leading international plantations group listed on the Malaysia stock exchange with a market capitalisation of approximately 4.7 Mrd. € as at the end of September 2022.
Temix Oleo is an oleochemical company focused on production of Esters mainly based on renewable feed stocks, and delivering solutions for lubricant, cosmetic, ceramic, coating, rubber and plastics industries. Based in Milan, Italy, Temix Oleo has a production plant in Calderara di Reno, Bologna, with over 100 employees and a turnover of 150 Mio. € in 2022.
KLKE has been assisted by KPMG Italy as financial advisor and for the financial and tax due diligences.
Hogan Lovells, Italian practice, acted as legal advisor for the legal matters.
Temix Oleo has been assisted by LCA Studio Legale for the legal matters.
For more information, please visit [www.klkoleo.com/klkemmerich](https://www.klkoleo.com/klkemmerich/en/) and [www.temixoleo.com](https://www.temixoleo.com/)

# Press Release: Peng Soon-Liu Ying Receive Support from KLK to Pursue Their Olympic Dream
07 Nov 2020
[Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”)](https://www.klk.com.my/), one of the leading plantation companies in Malaysia announces its sponsorship of World rank No 7 Badminton Mixed Doubles, Chan Peng Soon and Goh Liu Ying.  
The sponsorship, in line with its corporate responsibility effort to promote harmonious culture through sports as well as to support our nation’s pursuit for global sports excellence, it is hoped that the Rio silver medallists duo will continue to bring all Malaysians together and make the country proud when chasing their Tokyo Olympics dream.
KLK executive director Lee Jia Zhang said in a statement that, “We understand that the COVID-19 pandemic has changed many of our lives, we are humbled to be able to help ease the financial woes for our Malaysian Mixed Doubles during this difficult period. We hope that with our sponsorship, Peng Soon-Liu Ying can focus and be better prepared for the Games.”
The Tokyo Olympics was deferred for one-year to July 23 – Aug 8 in 2021 due to the pandemic. Although Peng Soon-Liu Ying had forgo the two Denmark Opens in October 2020, they are looking at making a return early next year for the two BWF Opens in Asia. The world No. 7 duo need to stay within the top 16 until next year to qualify for Tokyo Olympics 2021.
Chan Peng Soon has expressed his gratitude to KLK for the support given to Goh Liu Ying and him. “The deferment of this year’s Olympics also meant that we will need to continue to train to maintain our physical form for another 12 months, in which this will require extra financial expenses. Thank you KLK for coming forward to support us during this difficult time as it is not easy to find support and sponsorship during the COVID-19 pandemic”, said Chan.
“The money will help us cover the travel expenses for our future tournaments. We can now focus on qualifying for the Tokyo Olympics and hopefully achieve a better result for Malaysia”, said Liu Ying.
Since turning Pro as independent players, Peng Soon-Liu Ying have done well by winning the 2019 Thailand Masters and New Zealand Open.
The announcement also sees Peng Soon-Liu Ying become the first brand ambassadors for KLK’s [DavosLife E3 Complete](https://www.klkoleo.com/davoslife/estore/), a natural Vitamin E dietary supplement comprising Tocotrienols and alpha tocopherol derived from palm fruits. It is formulated for high bio-absorption and suitable for adults with busy lifestyle and elderly with symptoms of tiredness. Tocotrienols as an antioxidant is beneficial at neutralizing free radicals and may help support overall wellness and vitality and boost healthier body.

Also featured in [The Star](https://www.thestar.com.my/metro/metro-news/2020/11/07/company-backs-doubles-pairs-dream-of-competing-in-olympics) and [Ipoh Echo](https://www.ipohecho.com.my/2020/11/06/peng-soon-liu-ying-receive-support-from-klk-to-pursue-their-olympic-dream/).

# RAM Sustainability upgrades KLK’s overall Sustainability Rating to Gold1 from Gold2
01 Jul 2025
RAM Sustainability upgrades [Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad’s (“KLK”)](http://www.klk.com.my/) Sustainability Rating from Gold2 (G2) to Gold1 (G1) for the year 2025. This recognition reflects KLK’s continued progress in Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) performance.
The upgraded rating highlights KLK’s continuous improvements across the following key areas:
  1. **Environmental:** Progress in climate change reporting and effective implementation of Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions reduction initiatives that contributed to absolute GHG reductions in FY2024.
  2. **Social:** Committed to upholding human rights, guided by the Group Sustainability Policy and reinforced through No Recruitment Fee Policy. An independent human rights risk assessment has been completed in our plantation operations in Peninsular Malaysia, with ongoing assessment in Sabah and Indonesia next in line.
  3. **Governance:** The Group’s Sustainability Policy was updated in 2025 to meet the evolving industry expectations. In FY 2024, KLK for the first time obtained limited assurance on selected Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) and the Zoological Society of London’s Sustainable Palm Oil Transparency Toolkit (SPOTT) indicators. 

This upgrade affirms KLK’s ongoing efforts to integrate sustainability into our business operations. This recognition is a testament to the dedication of all colleagues and it serves as a strong foundation for our continued journey towards sustainable growth and responsible stewardship.
Read the report [here](https://www.klk.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/2025-06-17-KLK-RAM-2025.pdf)  
Find out more about KLK Group and their sustainability efforts at [www.klk.com.my](http://www.klk.com.my/)
**_About KLK OLEO_**
Built on a legacy of integrity, humility, innovation and loyalty, KLK OLEO is committed to providing the best sustainable solutions to address global demands and consumer trends. As a worldwide oleochemical producer with over 100 years of experience, KLK OLEO’s products can be found in most consumer staples, from Beauty & Personal Care, Food & Health Care, Home Care, Industries & Institutional Cleaning, Lubricants to Polymers.
KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of [KUALA LUMPUR KEPONG BERHAD (KLK)](https://www.klk.com.my/). A leading international Plantations group listed on the Main Board of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.

# Palm-Oleo (Klang) Sdn. Bhd.
[Home](https://www.klkoleo.com/) » Palm-Oleo (Klang) Sdn. Bhd.
In September 2007, KLK acquired Uniqema (M) Sdn. Bhd. (“UMSB”). The UMSB manufacturing facility was one of the earliest oleochemical plants in Malaysia, under the management of its previous owners Unilever and ICI/Uniqema/Croda. UMSB was subsequently renamed Palm-Oleo (Klang) Sdn. Bhd. (“POK”).
POK continues to manufacture its current range of products. The four key products are [PALMERA Fatty Acids](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmera-fatty-acids/) and [Glycerine](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmera-glycerine/), [PALMOSALT Soap Noodles](https://www.klkoleo.com/palmosalt-soap-download/palmosalt-soap-noodles/) and [PALMESTER Fatty Esters](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmester-fatty-acid-esters/palmester-fatty-acid-esters/). POK offers consistent, high quality [PALMOSALT Soap Noodles](https://www.klkoleo.com/palmosalt-soap-download/palmosalt-soap-noodles/) through the neutralisation of distilled fatty acid under advanced process control. The plant is able to customise its soap noodle composition as per customer requirements and by employing innovative solutions via its state-of-the-art soap technical centre, is able to produce specialty soap bases. [PALMESTER Fatty Esters](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmester-fatty-acid-esters/palmester-fatty-acid-esters/), which range from mono-esters to polyol-esters are used in a wide range of applications such as industrial lubricants, textiles, cleaning, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, polymers, food, paint, inks etc. to provide surfactancy, solvency and lubricity.
KLK OLEO’s R&D Centre is set up in POK as an international research, development and technology hub to service and support its global oleochemical business. The R&D team is specialised in organic synthesis, spearheading advanced analytical support, and driving the innovation of high-value applications for oleochemical derivatives. Through the establishment of this R&D Centre, the KLK OLEO Group has been able to leverage on partner relationships on numerous collaboration projects.
![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Palm-Oleo-K.jpg)  
  
**Palm-Oleo (Klang) Sdn Bhd**

# Palm-Oleo Sdn. Bhd.
[Home](https://www.klkoleo.com/) » Palm-Oleo Sdn. Bhd.
A joint venture between KLK, Mitsui & Co., Ltd., Miyoshi Oil & Fat Co., Ltd. and Asahi Denka Kyogo K.K., Palm-Oleo Sdn Bhd is one of the earliest resource-based manufacturing investments by KLK. It is one of the world’s largest standalone Oleochemical producers. In 2021, KSP Manufacturing Sdn Bhd and Palmamide Sdn Bhd’s operations are merged into Palm-Oleo. The plants produce [PALMERA Fatty Acids ](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmera-fatty-acids/)and [Glycerine](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmera-glycerine/), [PALMOSALT Soap Noodles](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmosalt-soap-noodles/), [PALMOWAX Fatty Acid Bis-Amides](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmowax-fatty-acid-bis-amides/), and a wide range of [PALMOCOL Alkanolamides](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmocol-alkanolamides/).
[PALMERA Fatty Acids ](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmera-fatty-acids/) is used extensively by many well-known international brands in industries such as pharmaceuticals, soap, and detergents cosmetics, food emulsifiers, varnishes and paints. Fatty Acids form the critical mass of many everyday products globally. [PALMERA Glycerine](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmera-glycerine/) also finds broad appeal in many industries due to its outstanding stability and quality consistency, crucial criteria for many of today’s products.
The natural [PALMOSALT Soap Noodles or Soap Bases](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmosalt-soap-noodles/) are produced utilising the fresh supplies of distilled Fatty Acids. [PALMOSALT](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmosalt-soap-noodles/) is widely sought by international luxury brands. It is biodegradable, 100% vegetable-based and produced from readily renewable and sustainable natural resources. Among the crucial winning merits of are its high degree of whiteness and purity and its excellent lathering properties, good skin feel and high perfume retention qualities.
[PALMOWAX Fatty Acid Bis-Amides](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmowax-fatty-acid-bis-amides/) (also known as EBS) is an excellent internal and external lubricant for thermoplastic and thermoset systems due to its much higher melting point than other primary amides. EBS functions as slip additive and releasing agent in moulded engineering metal parts. In masterbatch production, EBS is incorporated for added-value lubricating resin performance.
As nonionic secondary surfactants, [PALMOCOL Alkanolamides](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmocol-alkanolamides/) have been widely used for years in many liquid cleaning formulations. [PALMOCOL Alkanolamides](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmocol-alkanolamides/) are the preferred choice due to its nitrosamine-free feature resulting from our superior process technology. [PALMOCOL](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmocol-alkanolamides/) is an excellent thickener and foam booster in personal care, cosmetic and home care products.
Palm-Oleo’s superior product quality is guaranteed by a team of professionals working in an environment [certified](https://www.klkoleo.com/accreditations/) Halal, GMP, GMP+B2, HACCP, BRC Food, ISO 9001:2008, ISO 14001:2004 and ISO 45001:2018 standards.

[Home](https://www.klkoleo.com/) » PT Perindustrian Sawit Synergi
PT Perindustrian Sawit Synergi (PT PSS) is a refinery and Oleochemical complex located in East Kalimantan. It supports KLK Group’s efforts to grow its presence globally and strengthen its position as a fully integrated player in the palm oil industry.
Perindustrian Sawit Synergi includes essential facilities such as a jetty, power plant, refinery, and oleochemical plant to assist the Group’s operations in the region. Oleochemical raw materials are supplied by the company and exported to KLK OLEO’s other operating facilities for further processing into products such as [Fatty Acids](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmera-fatty-acids/), [Glycerine](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmera-glycerine/), [Soap Noodles](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmosalt-soap-noodles/), Triacetin, and [Fatty Acid Esters](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmester-fatty-acid-esters/).

# Stolthaven (Westport) Sdn Bhd
[Home](https://www.klkoleo.com/) » Stolthaven (Westport) Sdn Bhd
Established in a joint venture between KLK Berhad and Stolthaven in 2005, Stolthaven (Westport) Sdn Bhd is a storage terminal operator providing offering tailored storage solutions to a range of products including Chemical Solvents, Inorganic Products, Petroleum Products, Veg-Oil Products, Oleochemicals, Biofuel Feedstocks, and Advanced Biodiesel.
The terminal is equipped with a variety of tanks constructed from Mild Carbon Steel, Epoxy Coated Mild Carbon Steel, and Stainless Steel, providing flexible and secure storage options to suit diverse customer requirements.
Strategically situated just two kilometres from the Westport Container Terminal, Stolthaven Westport is instrumental in optimising oleochemical supply chains through integrated storage, handling, and distribution services. With a strong emphasis on safety, operational excellence, and adaptability to market dynamics, the terminal supports clients in maintaining seamless supply flows across the region.
Stolthaven Westport is both ISCC EU and ISCC Plus certified.

# Supply Chain Management
[Home](https://www.klkoleo.com/) » Supply Chain Management
### Supply Chain Management in KLK OLEO
Sustainability practices are the core values of KLK OLEO’s corporate culture. These values are incorporated into an extensive self-regulating practice which integrates the principles of sustainability into a stringent supply chain management. With the surge in world demand for environmental protection, high awareness for downstream compliance to sustainability regulations and standards is fast becoming a necessity.

# Sustainability Principled by Integrity
[Home](https://www.klkoleo.com/) » Sustainability Principled by Integrity
### Integrated, Reliable and Sustainable
KLK and its subsidiaries including KLK OLEO are committed to protecting all its resources and incorporating environmentally friendly methods into its practices policies.
At KLK OLEO, our principles on sustainability are guided by integrity.
A strong sense of community is important to us. KLK policy reaches deep into the social welfare of its communities, through the provision of education and accessible health care.
No deforestation and no new development in peat areas are the fundamental commitment from us that all oleochemicals produced are sustainable.
![EN Sustainability Principled by Integrity Chart](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/EN-Sustainability-Principled-by-Integrity-Chart-01.png)
After years of experience in multisite RSPO Supply Chain Certification since 2012, KLK OLEO is now having 14 manufacturing facilities certified, strategically located in Malaysia, Indonesia, China and Europe. Our capability in delivering Traceable, Segregated and Mass Balance certified oleo-based products enable KLK OLEO continues to grow as the most trusted global partner in oleo-based products and solutions.
Environmental management such as energy consumption, GHG emissions, water consumption, and solid waste generation are all closely monitored at sustainable levels.
KLK OLEO Sustainable Practices are recognised by world standards, and is an exemplary model to sustain the ecological balance of the environment, during the production and manufacturing of oleochemicals produced.
KLK OLEO. Trusted to enrich the global population with sustainability.

### Traceability at KLK OLEO
All sustainable produce must be traceable to its source of origin. Oleochemicals produced from KLK OLEO has a highly traceable palm oil supply chain which supports long-term ecological balance of the environment.  
  

View More
![KLK OLEO Traceability English](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/2024-02-26-Link-Tracebility-English.png)  

###### Notes:
Defined as traceable to Palm Oil Mills (“POM”) level for both Palm Oil based and Palm Kernel Oil based feedstock, excluding internal transfer within KLK OLEO group of companies.
The percentages disclosed were tabulated based on the weighted average purchases for palm oil related origin processed in participating operating centers.
The source of information shared, non-verified, included but not limited to:
  * Supplier specific traceability disclosure: Suppliers submitted traceability information upon request for certain period*, based on cloud of mills. Traceability percentage is calculated based on mills information provided. Should suppliers provide statements of certain percentage traceable to POM level, this was also used to represent traceability.
  * Supplier website traceability disclosure*: Information from supplier traceability dashboard.
  * CIF Rotterdam Traceability (CRT) Template**: Specific for Europe operating centers, CRT templates ex-vessel were used as source of information for traceability calculation.
  * RSPO certified purchases: Declaration of mills by suppliers in the RSPO PalmTrace and Prisma. Despite that, according to RSPO, the mill list is not fully available in the transaction records within Prisma, as the historical footprint from PalmTrace has not yet been migrated. The information will be updated as soon as it becomes available.
  * Mill list is updated to reflect latest sourcing whenever information is available.

  * *Traceability information not necessarily match sourcing period. Only RSPO SG model can provide exact matching of traceability against sourcing period.
  * ** Typically connect to shipments over the past 12 months. Suppliers that not in current supply chain, can therefore still appear on the mill list.

Taiko Palm-Oleo (Zhangjiagang) Co., Ltd. (“TPO”) was incorporated in January 2004 and operates an on-site plant at Zhangjiagang, China, manufacturing basic and intermediate oleochemicals. The plant, which was commissioned in 2006, produces [PALMERA Fatty Acids](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmera-fatty-acids/) and [Glycerine](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmera-glycerine/), [PALMOSALT Soap Noodles](https://www.klkoleo.com/palmosalt-soap-download/palmosalt-soap-noodles/), and [PALMESTER Triacetin](https://www.klkoleo.com/brand/palmester-fatty-acid-esters/palmester-fatty-acid-esters/). It is part of KLK OLEO’s global strategy to move into the fast growing Chinese market with the overall aim of enhancing its supply, distribution and services to its customers. The Zhangjiagang main warehouse operates as TPO’s hub in China and is supported by strategic branches and warehousing facilities at various locations in China, namely Shanghai, Guangzhou, Tianjin and Nanjing; each serving customers of a specific region.

# Effizient
![2025 RISE Thumbnail](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2025-RISE-Thumbnail-01.png)
KLK OLEO bedient unsere Kunden von erstklassigen Produktionsstätten aus, die strategisch in Malaysia, China, Indonesien, Europa und unserem neu gegründeten internationalen Vertriebsbüro in Amerika liegen.  
Mit einem Team von technisch-kaufmännischen Fachleuten sind wir bestrebt, die Vorteile von Marktkenntnissen, Verkaufsreaktionen und Formulierungs-unterstützung zu liefern, um die Effizienz zu maximieren und die Qualität Ihrer Produkte zu verbessern.  
Durch Präsenz in allen Regionen können wir schnell auf Ihre Anforderungen reagieren und Produkte auf höchstem Niveau just-in-time für Ihre Produktion liefern.  
Dies wird den CO2-Fußabdruck reduzieren und gleichzeitig die Produktintegrität und -qualität während der Handhabung und Lagerung gewährleisten.

crawl_media.description:
Join KLK OLEO at in-cosmetics Asia 2022 to discover their complete beauty and personal care ingredients.
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes, with 13 manufacturing facilities located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers basic, functional and bioactive ingredients which include Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols, Alkanolamides, Fatty Esters, Surfactants and Tocotrienols (Super Vitamin E).
KLK OLEO will showcase various sustainable beauty and personal care ingredients at this event. These ingredients cover multiple functional efficacies, such as:



Anti-Ageing
Emollient
Pearlescent
Green Surfactant


Foam Booster
Humectant
Opaficier
Viscosity Modifier


Thickener
Solubiliser
Emulsifier
and others…



Check out more here

KLK OLEO will be showcasing DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols for beauty from within application as well as PALMESTER MCT (Oil & Powder) at Health Ingredients (HI) Europe 2022.
DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols is a bioactive for dietary supplements, foods and beverages, cosmetic and personal care products. KLK OLEO received glowing reviews from customers who have tried and tested DavosLife E3 Bio-Enhanced 20 and DavosLife E3 DVP 30-WD in beauty from within nutraceutical products. Customers saw marked improvements in skin tone and youthfulness in 2 months.
PALMESTER MCT (Oil & Powder) is a versatile single or blend of saturated medium chain length caprylic/capric fatty acids derived from renewable natural raw materials. Research studies have shown that MCT has a lot of health benefits – in particular, it has a lot of cognitive health benefits. It can serve as an alternative fuel source for the brain, which is particularly important in Alzheimer’s disease and dementia.
Visitors can visit KLK OLEO booth (J50 at Hall 7.2) to understand how KLK OLEO can help to elevate your products.
Explore more about KLK OLEO here.

Palm-Oleo Sdn Bhd (Palm-Oleo) Fatty Acid & Glycerine (FAG) Plant and Soap Noodle & Amide (SNAM) Plant were both awarded the MSOSH Gold Class I Award. On 21st December 2022, the Malaysian Society of Occupational Safety & Health (MSOSH) held the spectacular event at the Sunway Resort Hotel. Both plant delegations were led by their respective General Managers, Dr. Liew Weng Hui and Ms. Lim Fong Nee.
While FAG Plant has achieved this feat for the second year in a row, it is significant this year that SNAM Plant has participated and stands tall together to represent KLK OLEO in an event attended by other leading oil and gas, utility, and chemical producer companies in Malaysia.
Ms Lim Fong Nee and Dr. Liew Weng Hui received the MSOSH trophy and plaque
The primary goal of Palm-Oleo’s participation in this yearly event is to assess and improve the current level of occupational safety and health standards, practises, and culture at Palm-Oleo. As a result, we can rest assured that Palm-Oleo is currently on the right path toward SHE excellence.
This recognition is in line with KLK Group’s aim to continuously practice and support the Group’s safety & health programme to ensure a better and safer workplace for all.
Palm-Oleo team posing with both Gold Class I plaques & trophies

Discover how KLK enrich human lives and beyond at Palm and Lauric Oils Price Outlook Conference & Exhibition 2023 (POC2023)!
Visit us to find out more!
More info about POC2023
About Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad
Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (KLK) is a leading international Plantations group established in 1906. KLK ventured into resource-based downstream with KLK Refineries and KLK OLEO in the manufacturing of specialty oils & fats, oleochemicals and its derivatives. A little bit of KLK is in everything we consume. Find out more at www.klk.com.my

From makeup, fragrances, skin and hair care to beauty and nutricosmetics, KLK OLEO will be showcasing various beauty and personal care ingredients, covering functional efficacies ranging from emollient, anti-ageing, pearlescing agent, foam booster, viscosity modifier, humectant, green surfactant, opacifier, emulsifier and many more.
Key Highlights:


[Featured Product] Emollient Sensory Journey
Visitors can experience an emollient sensory journey featuring PALMESTER Fatty Acid Esters. Derived from renewable plant source, PALMESTER range comprises Isopropyl Ester, Ethylhexyl Ester, Glyceryl Ester, Isostearate, Wax Esters, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Propylene Glycol or Butylene Glycol Ester each importing different characteristics, textures, performance and synergies within the formulation.
[Unveil New Formulation] DavosLife Ageless Serum with FACT Bioactive Complex
KLK OLEO will also be introducing DavosLife Ageless Serum with FACT Bioactive Complex. It features a synergistic antioxidant combination of Ferulic Acid, Vitamin C and Tocotrienols (FACT Bioactive Complex) to enhance protection against skin damage caused by free radicals. It improves signs of photodamage, the disappearance of lines and wrinkles, and sagging skin, while promoting a bright and clear complexion. crawl_media.alt: Davos Life Science & ColorNet Partnership: Transforming Brazil’s Skincare Future with the Power of Tocotrienols
crawl_media.description:
Davos Life Science Sdn. Bhd. as part of KLK OLEO Group, a global leader in natural palm-derived Tocotrienols, and ColorNet, a leading distributor serving Brazil’s beauty and personal care industry, are pleased to announce a strategic partnership to expand the availability of DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols in the Brazilian skincare market.
The partnership marks an important milestone for both organisations as ColorNet becomes Davos Life Science’s authorised distributor for the personal care segment in Brazil. Through this collaboration, both companies aim to introduce scientifically backed Tocotrienols solutions to cosmetic manufacturers and brand owners seeking innovative ingredients for skin health and beauty applications.
 
Reveal Natural Radiance. Restore Youthful Luminosity.
DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols — the “Extraordinary Super Vitamin E” — act on skin through three complementary mechanisms: potent antioxidant activity, powerful anti-inflammatory action, and gene modulation. This triple mode of action is documented across an extensive body of peer-reviewed research covering anti-ageing, skin brightening, blue light and pollution defence, and skin barrier support.
 
Clinically demonstrated in human studies

Reduces UV-induced skin redness by up to 26%
Reduces UV-induced tanning by up to 32%

 
Science Proven Multi-Pathway Benefits from published studies



Combats Oxidative stress — reduces DNA, lipid and protein oxidation markers: 8-OHdG by up to 66%, malondialdehyde by 44%, and protein carbonyl by 58%.
Benefits: Helps protect skin from premature ageing, and promotes healthier, more resilient skin.
Inflammatory response Calms Inflammation & Skin Irritation — downregulates key mediators: IL-6 by up to 64%, IL-8 by 72%, and COX-2 by 47%.
Benefits: Helps soothe redness and sensitivity, supports faster skin recovery, improves overall skin comfort.
Reduces Hyperpigmentation, Brightens Skin Tone Pigmentation — suppresses tyrosinase expression, reducing melanin production by up to 55%.
Benefits: Helps minimise dark spots and uneven pigmentation, promotes brighter and more radiant skin, and supports a more uniform skin tone.
Defends Against Pollution-Induced Skin Damage Pollution defence and barrier integrity — suppresses PM2.5-induced MAPK signalling, downregulating phosphorylation of p38 by 61%, JNK1/2 by 70% and ERK by 24%. Also protects cells from mitochondria-mediated apoptosis. Under the same conditions, alpha-tocopherol showed no strong inhibitory effect.
Benefits: Strengthens the skin barrier against urban pollution, helps prevent environmental ageing, enhances skin resilience, reduces visible signs of stress caused by external aggressors, and supports long-term skin vitality.



Learn more about the full skincare benefits of DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols.
 
Key Consumer Takeaway
Tocotrienols deliver clinically proven protection against the four major drivers of skin ageing: oxidative stress, inflammation, hyperpigmentation, and environmental pollution, resulting in healthier, brighter, younger-looking, and more resilient skin.
 
Sustainably Sourced. Fully Traceable.
DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols are sourced from sustainably managed palm plantations within the Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”) Group, the parent company of Davos Life Science, ensuring full supply chain traceability, consistent batch-to-batch quality, and reliable long-term supply security.
Davos Life Science, a subsidiary of Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (KLK), a leading diversified resource-based manufacturing and international plantation group, is a global producer of high-quality natural phytonutrients. The company specialises in DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols, the extraordinary full-spectrum vitamin E complex comprising of natural Tocotrienols and tocopherol, as well as DavosLife Biocarotene, the Natural Mixed Carotenes. Supported by KLK’s vertically integrated plantation operations and its resource manufacturing division, KLK OLEO, Davos Life Science ensures a sustainable and reliable supply of premium natural phytonutrients to the global market.
As a leader in specialty ingredients and chemicals, ColorNet is uniquely positioned to accelerate the adoption of premium bioactive ingredients in Brazil. By connecting innovative global technologies with local market opportunities, and drawing on its deep expertise in specialty ingredients, chemicals, skincare, and personal care, ColorNet serves as a strategic partner in bringing scientifically validated, high-efficacy bioactive solutions to market. Together, we can shape the future of performance-driven, innovation-led beauty and personal care products.

crawl_media.description:
PALMEROL Fatty Alcohols

															
														
								Description:
								PALMEROL Fatty Alcohols are high-quality fatty alcohols derived from vegetable oils and are available in various fractions. These fatty alcohols play a vital role in the production of household detergents, with mid-cut and long-chain types being the most in demand. The primary application of natural fatty alcohols lies in their conversion into derivatives for use in surfactants and detergent formulations.

Applications: Flavouring and fragrance ingredient.

 
Octyl Alcohol

PALMERA Glycerine

															
														
								Description:
								PALMERA Refined Glycerine is a high‑purity, colourless, odourless, hygroscopic, and viscous liquid derived from vegetable oils through classical oleochemical processes, including splitting and distillation.
Known for its versatility and quality, PALMERA Refined Glycerine is widely used across various industries—tobacco products, surface coatings, paper, inks, lubricants, textiles, urethane polymers, and more. It also serves as a key raw material for producing value‑added chemicals such as propylene glycol, epichlorohydrin, acrolein, and nitroglycerine.
Manufactured in compliance with stringent legal and quality standards, including GMP+ and HACCP, several PALMERA Refined Glycerine grades are suitable for use in food, flavours, feed, and personal care applications. Products meeting the specifications of relevant pharmacopoeias are also available for pharmaceutical use.

PALMFONATE Methyl Ester Sulphonates

															
														
								Description:
								PALMFONATE Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES) is KLK OLEO’s proprietary brand of anionic surfactant, widely recognised as the active cleaning ingredient in laundry detergents. Derived from Methyl Esters of natural fatty acids, this MES surfactant serves as a high-performing, eco-friendly alternative to traditional surfactants like Linear Alkyl Benzene Sulfonate (LABS).
Formulated from renewable natural resources, PALMFONATE offers superior detergency, excellent biodegradability, and enhanced calcium hardness tolerance during washing. These qualities make it ideal for both high-efficiency and conventional cleaning applications.
PALMFONATE MES is available in multiple formats—free-flowing powder, flakes, and paste—offering formulation flexibility. The powder grade allows for easy, direct post-addition into detergent formulas during manufacturing.

TENSAGEX Alcohol Ether Sulphates

															
														
								Description:
								Available in both Sodium Laureth Sulphate and Ammonium Laureth Sulphate forms, TENSAGEX products offer excellent cleansing, emulsifying, and foaming performance. As an anionic surfactant, TENSAGEX is widely used as a primary surfactant in rinse-off formulations, including personal care and household cleaning products.
Derived from natural fatty alcohols, TENSAGEX is characterised by its high purity and low levels of 1,4-dioxane, salt, and colour, aligning with current regulatory requirements across global markets.
To support customers’ sustainability goals, TENSAGEX is also available with RSPO Mass Balance (MB) certification, ensuring responsible sourcing of palm-derived ingredients.
We are also proud to announce the launch of our new sustainable ISCC+ certified Ether Sulfates, TENSAGEX MAX series. In the TENSAGEX MAX series, the ethylene oxide content is based on ethylene oxide derived from sustainable raw materials, such as recycled oils or natural oils. The ISCC+ certification ensures traceability through the Mass Balance approach.

社区

										在KLK，我们的价值观和关爱文化代代相传，并深植于我们的企业基因中。本着关爱和分享的精神，我们向各个社区的弱势群体伸出援手。我们将努力改善我们业务所在地区的社区生计。

Community
																	
														
								Care for People							
						

													
																	At KLK, our values and the culture of caring continues through the generations and is embedded in our corporate DNA. In the spirit of caring and sharing, we reach out and engage the less fortunate in various communities. We will endeavor to improve the livelihoods of the communities in areas where we operate.

教育

					我们相信，教育是积极推动社区未来改变和转型的重要因素。因此，我们寻求在我们开展业务的地区为那些可能无法获得此类机会的人和社区创造适当的教育机会和途径。

Education
																	
														
								Empowerment Through Education							
						

													
																	We believe that education is an important catalyst for positive change and transform the future of the community. As such, we seek to create appropriate education inroads and pathways in the areas where we operate for people and communities who may not be fortunate enough to have access to such opportunities.

员工

										员工是我们最宝贵的财富之一，他们的健康和福祉仍然是我们的首要任务。我们的目标是支持我们的员工成为最好的人，为他们提供环境和机会，鼓励并使他们过上健康的生活方式。

Employees
																	
														
								Health and Wellbeing							
						

													
																	Employees are one of our greatest assets and their health and wellbeing remain our top priority. We aim to support our employees to be the best they can be by providing them an environment and opportunities that encourage and enable them to lead a healthy lifestyle.

环境

										我们非常重视对环境的保护，这体现在我们的核心业务实践和政策中。我们坚信，我们的生计取决于我们和我们的子孙后代是否拥有一个更健康、更宜居的世界。

Environment
																	
														
								Harmony with Nature							
						

													
																	We place great importance on the protection and preservation of the environment and this is reflected in our core business practices and policies. We strongly believe that our livelihoods depend on a healthier, more livable world for us and our future generations.

Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”), one of the leading plantation companies in Malaysia announces its sponsorship of World rank No 7 Badminton Mixed Doubles, Chan Peng Soon and Goh Liu Ying.
The sponsorship, in line with its corporate responsibility effort to promote harmonious culture through sports as well as to support our nation’s pursuit for global sports excellence, it is hoped that the Rio silver medallists duo will continue to bring all Malaysians together and make the country proud when chasing their Tokyo Olympics dream.
KLK executive director Lee Jia Zhang said in a statement that, “We understand that the COVID-19 pandemic has changed many of our lives, we are humbled to be able to help ease the financial woes for our Malaysian Mixed Doubles during this difficult period. We hope that with our sponsorship, Peng Soon-Liu Ying can focus and be better prepared for the Games.”
The Tokyo Olympics was deferred for one-year to July 23 – Aug 8 in 2021 due to the pandemic. Although Peng Soon-Liu Ying had forgo the two Denmark Opens in October 2020, they are looking at making a return early next year for the two BWF Opens in Asia. The world No. 7 duo need to stay within the top 16 until next year to qualify for Tokyo Olympics 2021.
Chan Peng Soon has expressed his gratitude to KLK for the support given to Goh Liu Ying and him. “The deferment of this year’s Olympics also meant that we will need to continue to train to maintain our physical form for another 12 months, in which this will require extra financial expenses. Thank you KLK for coming forward to support us during this difficult time as it is not easy to find support and sponsorship during the COVID-19 pandemic”, said Chan.
“The money will help us cover the travel expenses for our future tournaments. We can now focus on qualifying for the Tokyo Olympics and hopefully achieve a better result for Malaysia”, said Liu Ying.
Since turning Pro as independent players, Peng Soon-Liu Ying have done well by winning the 2019 Thailand Masters and New Zealand Open.
The announcement also sees Peng Soon-Liu Ying become the first brand ambassadors for KLK’s DavosLife E3 Complete, a natural Vitamin E dietary supplement comprising Tocotrienols and alpha tocopherol derived from palm fruits. It is formulated for high bio-absorption and suitable for adults with busy lifestyle and elderly with symptoms of tiredness. Tocotrienols as an antioxidant is beneficial at neutralizing free radicals and may help support overall wellness and vitality and boost healthier body.
(From left) Jimmy Yow, Head of Sales and Marketing of KLK OLEO, Goh Liu Ying, Eric Tan, Senior Manager, Sales and Marketing of KLK Land, Chan Peng Soon and Lee Jia Zhang, Executive Director of KLK at the official signing ceremony
Apart from continued training, Peng Soon and Liu Ying also taking natural supplements to help increase sport endurance
Peng Soon and Liu Ying are the first Brand ambassadors for KLK’s DavosLife E3 Complete, a natural Vitamin E dietary supplement
Also featured in The Star and Ipoh Echo.

VitaFoods Europe is the leading nutraceutical event of the year, connecting health and nutrition business leaders throughout the entire supply chain. At this year’s VitaFoods Virtual Expo, Davos Life Science will be highlighting a potential new application of Tocotrienols as a bioactive to protect the body from pollution-induced oxidative stress and low-grade chronic inflammation.
Research studies have shown that prolonged exposure to environmental air pollution can increase morbidity and mortality. Air pollution induces oxidative stress in skin, lung, vascular and heart tissue, triggering redox-sensitive pathways that lead to biological processes like inflammation and cell death.
Davos Life Science will showcase new research data demonstrating how Tocotrienols can reduce oxidative stress and inflammation markers, alongside practical demonstrations of how Tocotrienols can be incorporated into functional foods and beverages, to emphasise the applicability of Tocotrienols as a bioactive for anti-pollution. This will drive product differentiation for businesses to help them answer a growing consumer need.
Our sales representatives, Mr. Jimmy Yow and Dr. Sharon Ling will be available for pre-scheduled online meetings (via Vitafoods Virtual Expo platform) throughout 7 to 11 September 2020, so book a slot to talk to them about how Tocotrienols can be incorporated into anti-pollution formulations.
We look forward to connect with you!

Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”), one of the leading plantation companies in Malaysia announces its sponsorship of World rank No 7 Badminton Mixed Doubles, Chan Peng Soon and Goh Liu Ying.
The sponsorship, in line with its corporate responsibility effort to promote harmonious culture through sports as well as to support our nation’s pursuit for global sports excellence, it is hoped that the Rio silver medallists duo will continue to bring all Malaysians together and make the country proud when chasing their Tokyo Olympics dream.
KLK executive director Lee Jia Zhang said in a statement that, “We understand that the COVID-19 pandemic has changed many of our lives, we are humbled to be able to help ease the financial woes for our Malaysian Mixed Doubles during this difficult period. We hope that with our sponsorship, Peng Soon-Liu Ying can focus and be better prepared for the Games.”
The Tokyo Olympics was deferred for one-year to July 23 – Aug 8 in 2021 due to the pandemic. Although Peng Soon-Liu Ying had forgo the two Denmark Opens in October 2020, they are looking at making a return early next year for the two BWF Opens in Asia. The world No. 7 duo need to stay within the top 16 until next year to qualify for Tokyo Olympics 2021.
Chan Peng Soon has expressed his gratitude to KLK for the support given to Goh Liu Ying and him. “The deferment of this year’s Olympics also meant that we will need to continue to train to maintain our physical form for another 12 months, in which this will require extra financial expenses. Thank you KLK for coming forward to support us during this difficult time as it is not easy to find support and sponsorship during the COVID-19 pandemic”, said Chan.
“The money will help us cover the travel expenses for our future tournaments. We can now focus on qualifying for the Tokyo Olympics and hopefully achieve a better result for Malaysia”, said Liu Ying.
Since turning Pro as independent players, Peng Soon-Liu Ying have done well by winning the 2019 Thailand Masters and New Zealand Open.
The announcement also sees Peng Soon-Liu Ying become the first brand ambassadors for KLK’s DavosLife E3 Complete, a natural Vitamin E dietary supplement comprising Tocotrienols and alpha tocopherol derived from palm fruits. It is formulated for high bio-absorption and suitable for adults with busy lifestyle and elderly with symptoms of tiredness. Tocotrienols as an antioxidant is beneficial at neutralizing free radicals and may help support overall wellness and vitality and boost healthier body.
(From left) Jimmy Yow, Head of Sales and Marketing of KLK OLEO, Goh Liu Ying, Eric Tan, Senior Manager, Sales and Marketing of KLK Land, Chan Peng Soon and Lee Jia Zhang, Executive Director of KLK at the official signing ceremony
Apart from continued training, Peng Soon and Liu Ying also taking natural supplements to help increase sport endurance
Peng Soon and Liu Ying are the first Brand ambassadors for KLK’s DavosLife E3 Complete, a natural Vitamin E dietary supplement
Also featured in The Star and Ipoh Echo.

KL-Kepong Oleomas Sdn Bhd (“KLKOM”) has successfully added Sodium Lauryl Sulphate (“SLS”) and Sodium Lauryl Ether Sulphate (“SLES”) into their product portfolio since the first quarter (Q1) of 2021. KLKOM is the second SLS and SLES production site of KLK OLEO group after KLK Tensachem, Belgium. The SLS and SLES manufactured by KLKOM are GMP-certified.
The addition of these two products makes the offering from KLK OLEO in Asia more complete, especially in the home and personal care industry.
Sodium Lauryl Sulphate (TENSOPOL SLS)
KLK OLEO produces TENSOPOL SLS with 100% renewable carbon. It is biodegradable, does not bio-accumulate in water or land, and has a natural origin index of 0.9 in accordance with ISO 16128. KLKOM can produce SLS in the form of needles, powder, as well as liquid.
SLS is one of the primary surfactants widely used in oral care, personal care and home care. SLS is also an effective surfactant used extensively in industrial applications to make floor cleaners, engine degreasers and machine wash detergents. Toothpaste can also use SLS in a lower concentration.

Sodium Lauryl Ether Sulphate (TENSAGEX SLES)
SLES is an anionic surfactant, widely used as a primary surfactant in rinse-off products, such as dishwashing liquid and shampoo.
Produced from natural fatty alcohols, TENSAGEX SLES features very high purity and low in 1,4-dioxane, salt and colour. It meets the latest regulatory restrictions for household cleaning products and personal care products.
TENSAGEX SLES is available as a high-active paste and also in the form of low active liquid for easy processing.

With state-of-the-art technology to be completed at the end of 2021, SLES with 1 moles EO produced from KLKOM could achieve 1,4 dioxane specs at 5ppm max, which is one of the most stringent specs in the industry.

Jaringan KLK OLEO telah berada di 9 negara berbeda di seluruh dunia dengan tenaga kerja lebih dari 3.000 karyawan secara global. Seiring dengan berkembangnya bisnis kami, maka kami percaya bahwa karyawan adalah aset terpenting bagi keberlanjutan dan pertumbuhan bisnis jangka panjang kami; oleh karena itu, kami terus mencari talenta terbaik untuk bergabung menjadi tenaga kerja di perusahaan kami.
Berkarier bersama KLK OLEO berarti Anda menjadi bagian dari hal yang istimewa di perusahaan kami. Dengan mengusung Visi dan Nilai Perusahaan, karyawan melaksanakan Misi kami untuk meningkatkan taraf hidup dan memberikan hasil bisnis yang lebih kuat dan efektif. Melalui kerangka kerja pengembangan dan kompetensi karyawan, kami yakin dapat meningkatkan kinerja karyawan dengan cara terbaik dan mendukung kesinambungan rencana bisnis.
Kami mencari talenta yang memiliki semangat, energi, antusiasme; dan yang lebih penting, selaras dengan Nilai Utama kami yang terdiri dari Teamwork, Humility, Results, Integrity, Innovation and Loyalty. Bergabunglah dan menjadi bagian dari tim kami, dan kami akan membantu mengembangkan potensi Anda secara penuh.

His Excellency Mr Pascal Grégoire, Belgium Ambassador to Malaysia, paid a courtesy visit to Palm-Oleo Klang (“POR”) and KL-Kepong Oleomas (“KLKOM”). He was accompanied by Mr Chua Choon Hwa, the Senior Undersecretary of Palm Oil and Sago Development Division from the Ministry of Plantation Industries and Commodities.
Palm-Oleo Klang is one of the world’s largest standalone Oleochemical producers. The plant produces PALMERA Fatty Acids and Glycerine; PALMOSALT Soap Noodles; PALMOWAX Fatty Acid Bis-Amides, and a wide range of PALMOCOL Alkanolamides.
KL-Kepong Oleomas is strategically located in West Port, Malaysia. This allows direct pipeline access from plant to port for fast and effective supply to international markets. The plant is also one of the world’s largest producers of natural fatty alcohols, producing a wide variety of high-quality oleochemical products. They also invest heavily in R&D in response to the industry’s constant evolution.

The King of Belgium has conferred upon the CEO of Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”) Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Lee Oi Hian the Commander of the Order of Leopold II during a private ceremony on 26 August 2021.
The prestigious National Order was officially presented to Tan Sri Lee on behalf of King Philippe of the Belgians by the Ambassador of Belgium to Malaysia His Excellency Pascal Grégoire. This award is given in honour of KLK Tensachem’s (part of KLK OLEO) transformation and contribution to the Sovereign of Belgium.
Tan Sri Lee giving his acceptance speech and looking on is Belgium Ambassador to Malaysia H.E. Pascal Grégoire
This Order, which was established on 24 August 1900, is awarded for meritorious service to the Sovereign of Belgium by Royal Decree, as a token of His personal goodwill. According to Mr Ambassador Grégoire, the Order is roughly equivalent to the British Victorian Order, which is a personal gift as well of the British monarch and has similar cases.
An ariel view of KLK Tensachem S.A. production site in Ougrée, Belgium
It was an honour to have other dignitaries to witness the momentous occasion. Also present at the ceremony was newly appointed Ambassador of Malaysia to Belgium H.E. Dato’ Ahmad Rozian Abd Ghani, Ambassador of the European Union to Malaysia H.E. Mr Michalis Rokas, Berjaya’s Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Vincent Tan and Belgium Embassy’s Deputy Head of Mission Mr Pierrick Massaux. The KLK OLEO team was represented by KLK OLEO CEO Mr Madhev Bala Subramaniam, Managing Director FAL & ME SBU Mr Raghunathan Nair and Managing Director MES Mr Chua Boon Hook.
Above from L-R: Ambassador of Malaysia to Belgium H.E. Dato’ Ahmad Rozian Abd Ghani, Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian, Tan Sri Vincent Tan, Belgium Ambassador H.E. Mr. Pascal Grégoire and Ambassador of the European Union to Malaysia H.E. Mr Michalis Rokas.

								Description:
								PALMESTER Fatty Acid Esters are used in a broad variety of different industrial applications such as cosmetics, toiletries, pharmaceuticals, food, metal working fluids, and etc.
Properties like lubrication, mould release, consistency promotion, emolliency, stability enhancement, spreading or fatty, solvency and cleaning demonstrate the large variety of functions offered by these unique products.
																
								    								
							

							Branched Fatty EstersCetyl Ethylhexanoate

Applications: Used in beauty & personal care. Vegetable-base, non-oily with a light silky skin after-feel.

 
Glyceryl 2-ethylhexanoate

Applications: Used in beauty & personal care. Vegetable-base and provides a non-greasy and cushiony feel.

Butyl EstersN-Butyl Stearate (nBS)

Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Flow promoter/plasticizer for injection molding grades of polystyrene; Lubricant in processing of synthetic fibers; Metalworking lubricant in rolling of aluminum.

Butylene Glycol EstersButylene Glycol Dicaprylate/Dicaprate

Applications:An emollient and skin conditioning agent for beauty and personal care products.

Ethylhexyl EstersEthylhexyl Cocoate (EHC)

Applications: Fatty acid ester derived from coconut fat with softening properties, non-occlusive and fine emollient.

 
Ethylhexyl Oleate (EHO)

Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Solvent for antibiotics and vitamins; After epoxidation as low temperature plasticizer for PVC; After sulphurisation as high pressure additive for lubricants.

Sympare Methyl Ester Sulphonates

															
														
								Description:
								Sympare Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES) is a sulphate-free anionic surfactant naturally made from plant source for use in the personal care categories. Sympare MES is listed in the CleanGredients database as it meets the EPA’s Safer Choice Standard. It is a sustainable alternative to petroleum-based surfactants in cleansing product formulations where product’s low irritation and mildness are benefits.
Sympare MES contains more than 50% of natural raw materials and is defined as derived natural ingredient according to ISO 16128. It is a suitable alternative ingredient recommended for high-growth natural consumer product categories such as baby care, personal care, and cosmetics.

KLK was selected as a recipient for the CSR Malaysia’s Company of the Year Award for Leadership in Community, Education, Scholarship and Welfare in the Sustainability & CSR Malaysia Awards 2021.

Organised by CSR Malaysia, the annually held awards initiative is a platform to celebrate outstanding achievers and inspire corporations for their efforts to create a better Malaysia through their sustainability and corporate social responsibility venture.
This is KLK’s second recognition from CSR Malaysia, as last year we received the Award for Sustainability & CSR Excellence (Plantation). The recipients were selected by an esteemed panel of judges representing media and social bodies. Judging criteria for the awards were based on the company’s clear purpose and goals in their CSR initiative, together with the impact created, and frequency of CSR events held.
Find out more about KLK’s Corporate Responsibility here: Values Matter. Society Matters.

Palm-Oleo Sdn Bhd (Palm-Oleo) has recently won the Malaysian Society for Occupational Safety and Health (MSOSH) Gold Class I Award in the MSOSH Award 2021. The award-giving ceremony was held on 25 November 2021 at Majestic Hotel, Kuala Lumpur.
Palm-Oleo participated in the MSOSH Award 2021 programme held between August to September 2021. The main objective of Palm-Oleo’s participation was to gauge the level of occupational safety & health standard, practice and culture currently in place at Palm-Oleo.

MSOH Award was also participated by several major oil and gas companies which were widely known for their high compliance in safety & health standards. With this win, it is heartening to note that Palm-Oleo is sharing the same platform in terms of SHE reputation along with these established multi-national companies.
This recognition is in line with KLK Group’s aim to continuously practice and support the Group’s safety & health programme to ensure a better and safer workplace for all.
Palm-Oleo team posing with the Gold Class 1 plaque & trophy

KLK OLEO announces today the appointment of Ralf Ewering as Chief Sustainability Officer Europe.
Ralf will drive and lead the development and delivery of the Europe region’s sustainability strategy to further establish KLK OLEO’s sustainability leadership in the Oleochemical industry.
“I’m excited to further drive momentum to KLK OLEO’s sustainability journey and work on the positive transition of our industry towards the people and our planet.” Ralf Ewering said.
Ralf has 27 years of experience in different managerial positions in the process industry and is working for 17 years in the oleochemical industry. Ralf holds a Master in Chemical Engineering from the Technical University of Dortmund.
At KLK OLEO, our principles on sustainability are guided by integrity. Sustainability is fundamental to how we conduct our business and we have a robust structure in place to facilitate the implementation of sustainability strategies across the Group. Our commitment to ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance) and Sustainability Policy enable KLK OLEO continues to grow as the most trusted partner in sustainable products and solutions.
About KLK OLEO
Built on a legacy of integrity, humility, innovation and loyalty, KLK OLEO is committed to providing the best sustainable solutions to address global demands and consumer trends. KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of KUALA LUMPUR KEPONG BERHAD (KLK). A leading international Plantations group listed on the Main Board of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.

KLK’s CEO, Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Lee Oi Hian was named The Edge Billion Ringgit Club (BRC) 2022’s Outstanding CEO & Value Creator in an awards ceremony held at Shangri-La Hotel, Kuala Lumpur.

The gala dinner and awards ceremony was graced by caretaker Finance Minister Tengku Datuk Seri Zafrul Abdul Aziz.
In his welcome speech last night, The Edge Media Group Chairman, Tan Sri Tong Kooi Ong hoped the BRC awards will bring out the best in every Malaysian company and its management. The awards were given based on genuine merit, with its methodology and evaluation criteria being transparent, verifiable and independently audited. Currently in its 13th year, Tan Sri Tong also hoped that as the BRC awards continue to evolve, business sustainability will also be a factor in the future. This too, was a sentiment that Tengku Zafrul echoed in his keynote address especially in creating a more sustainable and resilient economy by embracing the environmental, social and governance (ESG) principles.
Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian paid tribute to our Founder Chairman to whom he attributed his success and that of KLK’s, as having benefitted from the values laid down by the late Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng.
“I am humbled by this award because this is only possible through the help of many, including the Almighty God. We have to remain consistent, continue our journey based on values,” Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian said after accepting Malaysia’s Outstanding CEO & Value Creator Award.
KLK was also recognised in two other categories – Highest Growth in Profit After Tax Over Three Years in the Big Cap Companies (RM10 billion to RM40 billion Market Capitalisation) category and Highest Growth in Profit After Tax Over Three Years in the Plantation category. The awards were accepted on behalf of KLK by Mr. Lee Guo Zhang and Mr. Patrick Ng Chuan Peng respectively.

During the peak of Covid-19 pandemic, KLK OLEO as an approved essential industry, sustained efforts to maintain operations on units of demand, without compromising the health and wellbeing of the staffs – an invaluable asset. It clustered as a unified team, exercising multiple controls in curbing the spread of Covid-19, while operating on key areas of demand. A Covid-19 task force comprising senior management, working closely with its people, was formed across all its sites.
This award will prove as a catalyst for KLK OLEO to continue excelling in the Malaysian palm oil and oleochemical industry.

crawl_media.alt: KLK OLEO acquires Italian ester producer Temix Oleo
crawl_media.description:
Acquisition will expand KLK OLEOs’ product offering for Oleochemical.
Milan, Italy and Emmerich, Germany – Temix Oleo SpA (“Temix Oleo”) and KLK Emmerich GmbH (“KLKE”), a subsidiary of Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”), under its resource-based manufacturing division known as KLK OLEO, has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire a controlling stake in Temix Oleo (“the Transaction”).
KLK OLEO is a global integrated oleochemical producer (oleochemical, derivatives and specialty chemicals) with manufacturing sites in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of KLK, a leading international plantations group listed on the Malaysia stock exchange with a market capitalisation of approximately Euro 4.8 billion as at the end of September 2022.
Temix Oleo is an oleochemical company focused on production of Esters mainly based on renewable feed stocks, and delivering solutions for lubricant, cosmetic, ceramic, coating, rubber and plastics industries.
Temix Oleo is located in Milan, Italy with production plant in Calderara di Reno (Bologna) employing around 100 people with a turnover of Euro 150 million in 2022.
The Transaction is expected to be completed by April 2023, subject to regulatory approval and customary closing conditions.
“Temix Oleo outstanding reputation is built on their customer-centric and high-quality service business model. We are excited to welcome the Temix Oleo team and their excellent product portfolio to be part of the group of KLK (“KLK Group”)” said Sriganesh Mathur Subramanian, Managing Director, KLKE.
“This acquisition is an opportunity for Temix Oleo to continue to grow, in product portfolio and geographic areas, with focus on sustainability and innovation. Being part of the KLK Group, employees can look forward to a bright future.“ said Roberto Cella, Managing Director Temix Oleo.
For more information, please visit www.klkoleo.com/klkemmerich and www.temixoleo.com

In line with our sustainability commitment and in conjunction with the Palm & Lauric Price Outlook Conference (POC), KLK OLEO partnered with APE Malaysia (Animal Projects & Environmental Education Sdn. Bhd.) and planted 200 trees in the lower Kinabatangan River Wildlife Sanctuary in Sabah, Malaysia. These trees are to reconnect the forest corridors that serve as habitats for endangered animals.
The following trees were planted on plot 05°27’20.56″ E118°14’24.37″.

These trees will reach 5m in height in just 5 years and will converge with the rest of the trees to form the forest canopy in less than 10 years. We hope to hear gibbons and birds singing, monkeys swinging from tree to tree, and possibly an orangutan nesting high in the trees!
APE will provide updates on its reforestation site on their social media platforms, including Facebook, Twitter, Instagram or Youtube.

crawl_media.alt: First rooftop solar PV system in KLK OLEO
crawl_media.description:
Electricity is a key element in KLK OLEO’s manufacturing process and contributes significantly to process costs and greenhouse gas emissions. In 2022, the Group decided to invest in a rooftop solar photovoltaic (PV) system at Palm-Oleo (Klang) Sdn Bhd (POK). The solar PV system produces electricity that is environmentally friendly and sustainable by harnessing the sun’s energy.
A total of 1,576 monocrystalline solar PV modules were installed on available rooftops, including warehouses, loading bays and offices. Through the installation, POK can generate 1 GWh of renewable energy each year, about 5% of its electricity usage.
This system is one of KLK OLEO’s increased efforts to reducing greenhouse gas emissions and achieving Net Zero.
The new solar PV system has played a role in reducing greenhouse gas emissions

crawl_media.alt: KLK Malaysia’s Best Managed Companies in 2024 Collage
crawl_media.description:
KLK has once again been recognised as one of Malaysia’s Best Managed Companies in 2024. This marks the third consecutive year we have received this honour, reflecting our Company’s organisational success and contributions to the industry. The awards ceremony took place on 22 August, at Le Meridien Kuala Lumpur.
This year was particularly special, as KLK’s Executive Chairman, Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian was invited to be a guest speaker to share his insights on “Empowering the Next Generation for Business.”
Tan Sri Lee paid tribute to his father, the late Founder Chairman Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng, during his speech. He shared his experience as a second-generation leader and how he continued to build upon his father’s legacy. Additionally, he highlighted Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng’s subtle yet impactful mentorship and shared three valuable lessons:

 Core Values: “Integrity, humility, loyalty.” Values that Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng lived by, which continue to guide KLK’s dominant culture of T.H.R.I.I.L.
 Purpose in life: Finding fulfilment in life goes beyond wealth. It’s about creating a compassionate environment that impacts KLK’s 50,000 employees and their families. Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng reminded us to be good stewards of our stakeholders. Fulfilling this stewardship brings true contentment to life.
Balancing work and family: His ability to manage the demands of running a business while fostering family unity and solidarity.

 
KLK’s COO, Mr. Lee Jia Zhang, accepted the award on behalf of KLK. Ms. Lee Wen Ling, Managing Director of KLK Land, was also invited onstage to answer a few questions about the win.
When asked about the perception of the plantation industry as being part of the “old economy,” Ms. Lee responded: “I believe this view is inaccurate. As consumers become more conscious, there is a growing demand for sustainably produced products. To stay ahead, we must continue exploring and adapting, going beyond sustainability certifications to focus on areas like decarbonisation and traceability, among others.”
Also present at the award gala dinner were KLK Head of Corporate Mr. Teh Kwan Wey and Sustainability & Special Projects AGM Mr. Adrian Tan.
About KLK OLEO
Built on a legacy of integrity, humility, innovation and loyalty, KLK OLEO is committed to providing the best sustainable solutions to address global demands and consumer trends. As a worldwide oleochemical producer with over 100 years of experience, KLK OLEO’s products can be found in most consumer staples, from Beauty & Personal Care, Food & Health Care, Home Care, Industries & Institutional Cleaning, Lubricants to Polymers.
KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of KUALA LUMPUR KEPONG BERHAD (KLK). A leading international Plantations group listed on the Main Board of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.

crawl_media.alt: Press Release: KLK renews support to Malaysian Mixed Doubles Stars Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai
crawl_media.description:
Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK” or the “Group”) is proud to announce the renewal of our sponsorship for Malaysia’s national badminton mixed doubles pair, Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai, through 2025. This renewal reflects KLK’s continued commitment to support local sporting talent and fostering national pride.
Since 2023, KLK has been a proud supporter of the pair, who have made remarkable strides on the international stage. In addition to renewing their sponsorship, KLK has extended support to their coach, Teo Kok Siang, ensuring the team has the resources to excel in the coming year.
As part of this partnership, Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai will also serve as KLK Brand Ambassadors for DavosLife Science products, including DavosLife E3 Complete Tocotrienols and Revive Skin Care BeauE Collagen.
Commenting on the partnership, KLK Chief Operating Officer, Lee Jia Zhang said, “We are incredibly proud of Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai for their dedication and outstanding performance over the past year. Their perseverance and sportsmanship are inspiring and we wish them the very best as they compete in the upcoming PETRONAS Malaysia Open and the 2025 season.”
Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai expressed their heartfelt gratitude for KLK’s continued support, saying “Our journey as independent players has been challenging, yet incredibly rewarding. Securing funding and meeting our tournament commitments has been a significant hurdle. KLK’s unwavering trust in our potential, regardless of outcomes, has been empowering. This partnership has not only boosted our confidence but has also provided us the stability to focus on our performance and represent Malaysia with pride.”
Looking ahead, the duo shared their ambitious goals: “Our immediate target for the PETRONAS Malaysia Open is to advance to the quarterfinals. Beyond that, we aim to refine our performance, maintain consistency and break into the world’s top five rankings. In 2024, we came close to securing a Super 1000 championship title in China but narrowly missed it. For 2025 we are motivated to achieve that milestone.”
KLK looks forward to celebrate more milestones with Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai as they continue to thrive and make Malaysia proud in the 2025 season.
KLK Chief Operating Officer Mr. Lee Jia Zhang (centre) with Shevon Lai (left) and Goh Soon Huat (right) at the signing ceremony recently

As a global leader in oleochemical production, we offer a diverse portfolio ranging from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. crawl_media.description:
Integrated, Reliable and Sustainable
KLK and its subsidiaries including KLK OLEO are committed to protecting all its resources and incorporating environmentally friendly methods into its practices policies.
At KLK OLEO, our principles on sustainability are guided by integrity.
A strong sense of community is important to us. KLK policy reaches deep into the social welfare of its communities, through the provision of education and accessible health care.
No deforestation and no new development in peat areas are the fundamental commitment from us that all oleochemicals produced are sustainable.

After years of experience in multisite RSPO Supply Chain Certification since 2012, KLK OLEO is now having 14 manufacturing facilities certified, strategically located in Malaysia, Indonesia, China and Europe. Our capability in delivering Traceable, Segregated and Mass Balance certified oleo-based products enable KLK OLEO continues to grow as the most trusted global partner in oleo-based products and solutions.
Environmental management such as energy consumption, GHG emissions, water consumption, and solid waste generation are all closely monitored at sustainable levels.
KLK OLEO Sustainable Practices are recognised by world standards, and is an exemplary model to sustain the ecological balance of the environment, during the production and manufacturing of oleochemicals produced.
KLK OLEO. Trusted to enrich the global population with sustainability.

Traceability at KLK OLEO
All sustainable produce must be traceable to its source of origin. Oleochemicals produced from KLK OLEO has a highly traceable palm oil supply chain which supports long-term ecological balance of the environment.


View More

PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT Oil and Powder


Sourced from renewable natural ingredients, PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT delivers efficient energy in both oil and powder forms. Its 6–12 carbon chain structure allows for rapid absorption and quick energy release. The oil is neutral in taste, colourless, and odourless—ideal for functional food and beverage formulations. The powder offers versatility for meal replacements, active nutrition, and wellness products. Whether for performance or everyday vitality, PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT drives innovation across today’s nutrition landscape.
 

Supporting Health Through Functional Nutrition


With a metabolic pathway distinct from long-chain fats in the human body, PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT delivers quick energy, supports weight management, and fits well into ketogenic and digestive-friendly diets.
 

Versatile Applications Across Food Innovation


PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT enhances nutritional value and product functionality across diverse applications, from indulgent spreads to next-generation meat alternatives, helping formulators achieve the ideal balance of health, taste, and performance.
In Sauces and Dressings, it enables up to 40% fat substitution without the need for reformulation, delivering ideal texture, sensory appeal, and storage stability.
In Plant-based Meat, it improves chewiness and elasticity, supports oxidative stability, offers potential for full fat replacement, and helps reduce calories by up to 18%.
MCT is a flexible ingredient that fits easily into a wide range of food and beverage formats, supporting both everyday and emerging health-focused innovations.
KLK OLEO offers PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT oil in various grades, while MCT powders are available in different oil loadings to suit specific formulation needs.

PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT Oil and Powder


Sourced from renewable natural ingredients, PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT delivers efficient energy in both oil and powder forms. Its 6–12 carbon chain structure allows for rapid absorption and quick energy release. The oil is neutral in taste, colourless, and odourless—ideal for functional food and beverage formulations. The powder offers versatility for meal replacements, active nutrition, and wellness products. Whether for performance or everyday vitality, PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT drives innovation across today’s nutrition landscape.
 

Supporting Health Through Functional Nutrition


With a metabolic pathway distinct from long-chain fats in the human body, PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT delivers quick energy, supports weight management, and fits well into ketogenic and digestive-friendly diets.
 

Versatile Applications Across Food Innovation


PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT enhances nutritional value and product functionality across diverse applications, from indulgent spreads to next-generation meat alternatives, helping formulators achieve the ideal balance of health, taste, and performance.
In Sauces and Dressings, it enables up to 40% fat substitution without the need for reformulation, delivering ideal texture, sensory appeal, and storage stability.
In Plant-based Meat, it improves chewiness and elasticity, supports oxidative stability, offers potential for full fat replacement, and helps reduce calories by up to 18%.
MCT is a flexible ingredient that fits easily into a wide range of food and beverage formats, supporting both everyday and emerging health-focused innovations.
KLK OLEO offers PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT oil in various grades, while MCT powders are available in different oil loadings to suit specific formulation needs.

For a full century, the site along the Langestraat has been a familiar landmark for anyone passing through this corner of Twente. The chimney that once bore the name Servo is long gone, but the chemical company behind it, today known as KLK Kolb Specialties B.V., part of KLK OLEO Surfactants, remains deeply woven into the fabric of the region. A centenary worth celebrating.
The seven-hectare site is a world of its own. Laboratories, research facilities and towering reactors holding tens of thousands of litres operate virtually without pause, the only exception being public holidays. Visitors quickly learn the rules: beyond a clearly marked yellow line, only specially approved mobile phones are permitted. Safety is non-negotiable in this industry.
From Delden into Every Home
The plant does not manufacture finished consumer products. Instead, it produces surfactants, which are surface-active agents that allow oil and water to mix, or make substances soluble that would otherwise refuse to dissolve. These chemical building blocks end up in shampoos, laundry detergents, wall paints and textiles. In other words, there is a good chance something made in Delden is sitting in your home right now.
From a Steam Laundry to a Global Group
The story begins in 1926, when two local entrepreneurs, Kuiper and Rozenbroek, set up shop in a disused steam laundry after their original plan to build in Enschede fell through. They served the Twente textile industry, and during the Second World War even pivoted to food production when circumstances demanded it.
Decades of growth, restructuring and ownership changes followed. Locally the site is still affectionately called Servo, even though that name was officially retired in 2000 and the iconic chimney demolished in 2018. Today the company is owned by Swiss-based Kolb Distribution Ltd., itself part of KLK OLEO, the oleochemical arm of Malaysian conglomerate Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad.
More Than Just a Factory
The site is unusually well-equipped for an industrial location. It has its own volunteer fire brigade, a dedicated wastewater treatment plant, and most remarkably, a private railway spur that branches off the Zutphen–Oldenzaal line and runs directly onto the premises. Freight trains have used this connection for decades to deliver raw materials straight to the factory floor.
The railway has not always run without incident. In the early 1980s a wrongly set switch accidentally directed a passenger train onto the site. It was stopped in time, nobody was hurt, and the story has since become part of company folklore.
Three Generations, Fifty-Year Careers
Walk through the site with a long-serving colleague and you quickly sense that this is more than just a workplace. Over 200 people are employed here, the vast majority from Delden and the wider Twente area, with many of them cycling in each morning. Staff turnover is remarkably low: three employees recently marked 40 years of service, and last year one colleague reached 50. There are families where three generations have worked on the same site, and farmers’ sons who once looked for a temporary job and never left. That kind of loyalty speaks for itself.
Centenary Celebrations
The anniversary programme ran across several days. A business reception took place on Thursday 30 April, followed on Friday 1 May by a gathering for retirees and former staff, with dignitaries including the mayor, a provincial executive and the Count of Twickel in attendance, and an evening party for current employees.
On Saturday 2 May, the site opened its doors to the general public. As production continues around the clock and safety rules are strict, visitors were guided around the grounds by bus. The programme included live demonstrations by the company fire brigade and a kids’ science lab.
From a small chemical supplier for the local textile industry to a global player in specialty chemistry; one hundred years of growth, resilience and community. The story of KLK Kolb Specialties is far from over, and the next hundred years have already begun.
